question.zh: 图像怎样形成和存储？
question.en: How are images formed and stored?

why.zh: 测试台需要图像与成像模型。
why.en: The test station needs images and a camera model.

task.zh: 把图中的值填入空格。
task.en: Copy the values into the empty grid.

task.zh: 选出坐标 (2, 0) 的像素。
task.en: Select the pixel at (2, 0).

task.zh: 把右边的像素设为蓝色 (0, 0, 1)。
task.en: Set the pixel on the right to blue (0, 0, 1).

task.zh: 把每张图和变化方式配对。
task.en: Match each image to the kind of change.

task.zh: 移动物点，使投影落在目标上。
task.en: Move the point so its projection reaches the target.

task.zh: 调整距离，让像高为 1。
task.en: Adjust depth until the image height is 1.

task.zh: 调整像平面距离，让像高为 2。
task.en: Adjust the image plane distance until the image height is 2.

task.zh: 选出至少两组像高为 1、距离不同的组合。
task.en: Choose at least two pairs with image height 1 at different depths.

task.zh: 抄下数组的值。
task.en: Copy the values of the array.

task.zh: 交出图在 (x, y) 处的值。
task.en: Give the image value at (x, y).

task.zh: 读出图像在 (x, y) 的值。
task.en: Read the image value at (x, y).

task.zh: 读取像素 (x, y) 的 c 通道。c 的 0、1、2 分别代表 R、G、B。
task.en: Read channel c at pixel (x, y). Channels 0, 1, 2 mean R, G, B.

task.zh: 交换图像的红色与蓝色通道，保留绿色。输入 r、g、b 是对应的通道编号。
task.en: Exchange red and blue channels while retaining green. Inputs r, g, b identify the channels.

task.zh: 将蓝、红、绿通道依次作为输出的红、绿、蓝通道。
task.en: Use the blue, red, and green channels as the output red, green, and blue channels, respectively.

task.zh: 调整光圈，使进光量为 4。
task.en: Adjust the aperture until collected light is 4.

task.zh: 调整对焦距离，让远处物体清晰。
task.en: Adjust focus until the far object is sharp.

task.zh: 保持对焦距离，调整光圈，使清晰深度范围至少为 3000 毫米。
task.en: Keep focus fixed and adjust the aperture until the sharp depth range is at least 3000 mm.

task.zh: 读取从左上角开始、大小为 w × h 的区域。
task.en: Read a w × h region starting at the upper-left corner.

task.zh: 把一行坐标全部增加起点 x0。
task.en: Offset each coordinate in a row by x0.

task.zh: 截取左上角为 (x0, y0)、大小为 w × h 的区域。
task.en: Crop a w × h region starting at (x0, y0).

task.zh: 截取指定区域。
task.en: Crop the specified region.

task.zh: 交出与原图同样宽高的横坐标图和纵坐标图。
task.en: Output horizontal and vertical coordinate images matching the input dimensions.

task.zh: 从图像宽度减去右侧留出的 margin，交出对应的横向位置。
task.en: Subtract the right margin from the image width to obtain the horizontal position.

task.zh: 按 (dx, dy) 移动图像，空出的位置填 0。
task.en: Move the image by (dx, dy), filling uncovered cells with 0.

task.zh: 先移动图像，再截取指定区域。
task.en: Translate the image, then crop the specified region.

task.zh: 将端点 0 到 2 均匀分成五个位置。
task.en: Place five evenly spaced positions from 0 to 2.

task.zh: 交出 x 的下一个位置。
task.en: Output the position following x.

task.zh: 把每个横坐标按倍数 2 拉开，交出新坐标图。
task.en: Multiply each horizontal coordinate by 2.

task.zh: 把 length 按 scale 放大，再均分为 n 段；交出每段长度。
task.en: Scale length by scale, divide it into n equal intervals, and output one interval length.

task.zh: 把 length 按 n 等分，交出每段长度向下取整后的值。
task.en: Divide length into n equal intervals and round the interval length down.

task.zh: 将 a 向下取整；如果结果小于 b 交出 1，否则交出 0。
task.en: Round a down; output 1 if the result is less than b and 0 otherwise.

task.zh: 当 a 小于 b 时交出 a，否则交出 b。
task.en: Output a when a is less than b, otherwise output b.

task.zh: 交出 a 和 b 中较大的数。
task.en: Output the larger of a and b.

task.zh: 原轴有 m 个位置，新轴有 n 个位置；交出新位置 i 对应的原坐标。首尾对齐；n 为 1 时取原轴中心。
task.en: Given m source positions and n output positions, map output i to a source coordinate. Align endpoints; for n = 1 use the source centre.

task.zh: 把宽为 n 的输出坐标映射到宽为 m 的原图。输出为一行。
task.en: Map n output positions to source width m. Output one row.

task.zh: 用最近邻把图缩放到 w × h。首尾对齐；只有一个位置时取原图中心。等距时取较大坐标。
task.en: Resize to w × h using nearest neighbours. Align endpoints; for one sample use the source centre. Break ties towards the larger index.

task.zh: 用双线性插值缩放到 w × h；首尾对齐，单个输出位置取原图中心。
task.en: Resize to w × h using bilinear interpolation; align endpoints and use the source centre for a single output position.

task.zh: 分别交出最近邻和双线性缩放结果。
task.en: Output the nearest-neighbour and bilinear resize results.

task.zh: 显示把小于 0 的亮度画为 0，大于 1 的画为 1。填出显示亮度。
task.en: Display maps brightness below 0 to 0 and above 1 to 1. Fill in the displayed brightness.

task.zh: 交出 a 和 b 中较小的数。
task.en: Output the smaller of a and b.

task.zh: 把 0 至 1 均匀分为 L 个亮度，取最近值；等距时取较大值。范围外先限制到 0 至 1。
task.en: Use L evenly spaced brightness levels from 0 to 1; choose the nearest, breaking ties upwards. Clamp values outside the range.

task.zh: 将输入量化为 3 个等级。
task.en: Quantise the input to 3 levels.

task.zh: 裁剪指定区域，双线性缩放到目标宽高，再量化到 L 个等级。
task.en: Crop the given region, resize it bilinearly, then quantise it to L levels.

task.zh: 截取指定区域，然后用最近邻缩放到目标宽高。
task.en: Crop the given region, then resize it using nearest-neighbour sampling.

naive.zh: 先缩放整幅图再按旧坐标裁剪。
naive.en: Resize the full image before applying the original crop coordinates.

why.zh: 外观变化与证据判断互不依赖。
why.en: Appearance variation and evidence do not depend on one another.

why.zh: 针孔投影与数组坐标各自建立。
why.en: Pinhole projection and array coordinates can be learned independently.

why.zh: 图像运算与透镜实验互不依赖。
why.en: Image operations and lens experiments do not depend on one another.

about.zh: 空间滤波及后续视觉专题
about.en: Spatial filtering and later vision topics

why.zh: 本次只制作第 0、1 章。
why.en: This scope covers chapters 0 and 1.

about.en: Output specifications

wall.zh: 不同视觉问题要求不同形状的答案。
wall.en: Different questions require different kinds of output.

about.en: Viewpoint changes

wall.zh: 相同物体可能产生不同图像。
wall.en: The same object can produce different images.

about.en: Evidence and counterexamples

wall.zh: 一张图不能保证唯一场景或模型总是正确。
wall.en: An image need not identify one world or establish universal correctness.

about.en: Pixels and channels

wall.zh: 图像的数值、位置和颜色需要区分。
wall.en: A picture has numerical values, positions and colour channels.

about.en: Pinhole projection

wall.zh: 真实场景中的距离不能直接从图像位置读出。
wall.en: A scene point’s depth is not directly available from its image location.

about.en: Array coordinates

wall.zh: 行列与图像中的水平和竖直坐标容易混淆。
wall.en: Image coordinates and array rows and columns are easy to confuse.

about.en: Pixel lookup

wall.zh: 知道坐标还不能自动读取该处的值。
wall.en: Knowing a coordinate does not yet read its value.

about.en: Select a channel

wall.zh: 一个颜色像素包含多个数。
wall.en: A colour pixel contains several values.

about.en: Compose colour channels

wall.zh: 独立的通道需要重新成为一张彩色图。
wall.en: Separate channels need to become one colour image.

about.en: Coordinate grids

wall.zh: 需要为输出的每个位置确定读取源的位置。
wall.en: Each output position needs a source position.

about.en: Coordinate arithmetic

wall.zh: 输出和来源的位置可以不同。
wall.en: The output position can differ from its source.

about.en: Cropping

wall.zh: 需要从图像中提取指定窗口。
wall.en: A specified window must be extracted from an image.

about.en: Image dimensions

wall.zh: 平移输出需要与输入尺寸一致。
wall.en: A translation must preserve the input dimensions.

about.en: Translation

wall.zh: 裁剪窗口本身不能移动画面。
wall.en: A crop does not move content within the image.

about.en: Nearest-neighbour resampling

wall.zh: 新网格位置可能不落在原有样本上。
wall.en: New positions may lie between existing samples.

about.en: Bilinear interpolation

wall.zh: 最近邻会产生阶梯。
wall.en: Nearest-neighbour interpolation gives step-like transitions.

about.en: Values and display

wall.zh: 显示亮度与存储值可能不同。
wall.en: Displayed brightness can differ from stored values.

about.en: Quantisation

wall.zh: 有限取值无法区分任意接近的数。
wall.en: Finitely many levels cannot distinguish arbitrarily close values.

about.en: Lenses and focus

wall.zh: 理想针孔没有刻画透镜的聚焦和光圈。
wall.en: An ideal pinhole does not describe lens focus and aperture.

about.en: Coordinate differences

wall.zh: 位置和位移不能只靠相加表示。
wall.en: A source coordinate may require subtracting an offset.

about.en: Constants

wall.zh: 某些任务需要输入中没有的固定数。
wall.en: Some tasks require a fixed number not supplied as an input.

about.en: Scaling

wall.zh: 坐标差可能需要乘以比例。
wall.en: A coordinate difference may need scaling.

about.en: Division

wall.zh: 需要在指定范围分配样本。
wall.en: Samples must be distributed over a given range.

about.en: Rounding down

wall.zh: 连续位置还不是整数索引。
wall.en: A continuous position is not yet an integer index.

about.en: Comparison

wall.zh: 选择结果需要区分数值大小。
wall.en: A choice needs a way to distinguish values.

about.en: Conditional selection

wall.zh: 比较的结果需要控制一个输出。
wall.en: A comparison must be able to control an output.

about.en: The larger value

wall.zh: 多处需要选择两个数中较大的数。
wall.en: Multiple tasks need the larger of two values.

about.en: The smaller value

wall.zh: 多处需要选择两个数中较小的数。
wall.en: Multiple tasks need the smaller of two values.

about.en: Sampling coordinate mapping

wall.zh: 不同尺寸的网格需要一致的坐标对应。
wall.en: Grids of different sizes need a consistent coordinate mapping.

value.zh: 对照一张图存着的数和它显示出的样子，填出每格显示的值；再把 OpenCV 读进来的几个 uint8 像素写成 [0, 1] 里的 (R, G, B)。
value.en: Compare an image's stored numbers with how it is displayed and fill in each cell's displayed value; then write a few uint8 pixels read by OpenCV as (R, G, B) in [0, 1].

value.zh: 对照一张图存着的数和它显示出的样子，填出每格显示的值，再把一张 uint8 图的值换成 [0, 1] 里的数。
value.en: Compare an image's stored numbers with how it is displayed, fill in each cell's displayed value, then convert a uint8 image's values to numbers in [0, 1].

value.zh: 第二个任务给 OpenCV 读进来的 uint8 像素 [255, 128, 0]：玩家照写成 (1, 0.5, 0) 判错，按 BGR 顺序、除以 255 写成 (0, 0.5, 1) 才对；同一个像素可以按不同的范围、类型和通道顺序存。
value.en: The second task gives the uint8 pixel [255, 128, 0] as read by OpenCV: writing (1, 0.5, 0) fails; reading it as BGR and dividing by 255 gives (0, 0.5, 1); one pixel can be stored in different ranges, types and channel orders.

value.zh: 第二个任务给一张 uint8 的图：255 是白，换成 [0, 1] 是 1；玩家看出同一张图可以按两种范围和类型存。
value.en: The second task gives a uint8 image: 255 is white, which is 1 in [0, 1]; the player sees that one image can be stored in two ranges and types.

value.zh: 第二个任务给 OpenCV 读进来的 uint8 像素 [255, 51, 0]：玩家照写成 (1, 0.2, 0) 判错，按 BGR 顺序、除以 255 写成 (0, 0.2, 1) 才对；同一个像素可以按不同的范围、类型和通道顺序存。
value.en: The second task gives the uint8 pixel [255, 51, 0] as read by OpenCV: writing (1, 0.2, 0) fails; reading it as BGR and dividing by 255 gives (0, 0.2, 1); one pixel can be stored in different ranges, types and channel orders.

value.zh: 第二个任务给 OpenCV 读进来的 uint8 像素 [255, 128, 0]：玩家照写成 (1, 0.5, 0) 判错，按 BGR 顺序、除以 255 写成 (0, 0.5, 1) 才对；同一个像素可以按不同的范围、类型和通道顺序存。
value.en: The second task gives the uint8 pixel [255, 128, 0] as read by OpenCV: writing (1, 0.5, 0) fails; reading it as BGR and dividing by 255 gives (0, 0.5, 1); one pixel can be stored in different ranges, types and channel orders.

why: The domain step: the pinhole bench's sensor is built

value.zh: 针孔台的 setup 加了 objects（几支箭，各从 X 到 X + H，可各有深度）和 sensor（height、width 毫米，pxHeight、pxWidth 像素，主点在中心）；读数多了 u_px、h_px、各物体的 u_<id>、h_<id>、in_<id>（及 _px）、inView、allIn、fpx、fov、fovW；target.of 可以是 u_px、h_px。侧视图画出传感器的边，出画的物体虚着画并标出（games/DESIGN.md 6.8）。
value.en: The pinhole setup gains objects (arrows from X to X + H, each at its own depth or the knob Z) and sensor (height, width in mm; pxHeight, pxWidth in pixels; principal point at the centre); readings add u_px, h_px, each object's u_<id>, h_<id>, in_<id> (and _px), inView, allIn, fpx, fov, fovW; target.of may be u_px or h_px. The side view draws the sensor's edges and dashes and marks what falls out of view (games/DESIGN.md 6.8).

why: Chapter 0 from the new blueprint: the old levels and glossary go, the station's nine levels come in

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 检查台收到一张照片和几个关于它的问题。它自己不会看图，只能从几份现成的输出里挑：每份输出是某个视觉系统交出的答案。
t.en: The test station receives a photo and a few questions about it. It cannot look at the photo itself; it can only choose among ready-made outputs, each the answer some vision system handed in.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图里有哪些物体、它们在哪里，一个答案至少要带上哪些信息？读每份输出里写了什么，为每个问题选出够回答它、又不多带东西的那一份。
t.en: This level asks: which objects are in the picture and where are they — what must an answer contain at the least? Read what each output says, and give every question the output that answers it without carrying anything more.

after.zh: 给出每个物体的类别和框，这样的输出是<wiki-ref to="detection"></wiki-ref>的结果；只给类别是分类。
after.en: An output that gives each object a class and a box is the result of <wiki-ref to="detection"></wiki-ref>; a class alone is classification.

brief.zh: 为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的输出。
brief.en: For each question, choose the output that is just enough to answer it.

hint.zh: 先读每份输出里写了什么：它说了「是什么」，还是也说了「在哪里」？
hint.en: First read what each output actually says: does it say what is there, or also where?

hint.zh: 图里有两个物体时，「在哪里」要对每一个都答得上。
hint.en: With two objects in the picture, 'where' has to be answered for each of them.

prompt.zh: 图里有猫吗？
prompt.en: Is there a cat in the picture?

prompt.zh: 这两只猫各在图的哪里？
prompt.en: Where in the picture is each of the two cats?

prompt.zh: 画面里的每辆车是哪种车、停在哪里？
prompt.en: What kind of vehicle is each one in the picture, and where is it parked?

prompt.zh: 画面里有公交车吗？
prompt.en: Is there a bus in the picture?

t.zh: 有的输出不止给一个框，而是给每个像素一个数：一张和照片一样大的图。0 是背景，其余的数是什么意思，要从图里读出来。
t.en: Some outputs give not a box but a number for every pixel: a map as large as the photo. 0 is background; what the other numbers mean has to be read from the map.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：「每个像素属于哪一类」和「每个像素属于哪一个物体」是同一个问题吗？对着每张图里的数，为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的那张。
t.en: This level asks: is 'which class does each pixel belong to' the same question as 'which object does each pixel belong to'? Reading the numbers in each map, give every question the map that is just enough to answer it.

after.zh: 给每个像素标出它属于哪一个物体，叫<wiki-ref to="instance-segmentation"></wiki-ref>；只标类别的是语义分割。
after.en: Labelling each pixel with the object it belongs to is <wiki-ref to="instance-segmentation"></wiki-ref>; labelling only the class is semantic segmentation.

brief.zh: 为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的那张逐像素图。
brief.en: For each question, choose the per-pixel map that is just enough to answer it.

hint.zh: 数一数每张图里出现了几种不为 0 的数，再看它们各占哪些格子。
hint.en: Count how many different non-zero numbers each map holds, and which cells each covers.

hint.zh: 一块连成片的区域不一定就是一个物体。
hint.en: One connected region is not necessarily one object.

prompt.zh: 图里有几只狗，每只占哪些像素？
prompt.en: How many dogs are there, and which pixels does each cover?

prompt.zh: 哪些像素是狗？
prompt.en: Which pixels are dog?

prompt.zh: 一根柱子挡在一只狗前面：图里一共有几只狗？
prompt.en: A post stands in front of one dog: how many dogs are there in all?

prompt.zh: 柱子以外，哪些像素是狗？
prompt.en: Apart from the post, which pixels are dog?

t.zh: 一辆车上的视觉系统同时交出五份输出：一个标签、一组框和三张逐像素图。检查台要把车上各个模块的请求分给它们。
t.en: The vision system on a car hands in five outputs at once: a label, a set of boxes and three per-pixel maps. The station must route the requests of the car's modules to them.

t.zh: 和前面不同，这里一个请求可以有几份够用的输出，选出其中任何够用的都算对。要看清的是每份输出里的数是什么意思、以什么为单位：「那辆车离我多远」该由哪一份回答？
t.en: Unlike before, a request may have several sufficient outputs, and choosing any that suffice is right. What matters is what the numbers in each output mean, and in what unit: which output answers 'how far away is that car'?

brief.zh: 为每个请求选出能回答它的输出，够用的都可以选。
brief.en: For each request, choose outputs that answer it; any that suffice may be chosen.

hint.zh: 三张图的格子里都是数：对照图里的物体，猜出每张图的数是编号、类别还是长度。
hint.en: All three maps hold numbers: compare them with the scene and work out whether each map's numbers are ids, classes or lengths.

prompt.zh: 路面是哪些像素？
prompt.en: Which pixels are road?

prompt.zh: 每个行人各在哪里？
prompt.en: Where is each pedestrian?

prompt.zh: 第 2 行第 4 列那个像素处的车，离相机多远？
prompt.en: How far from the camera is the car at row 2, column 4?

prompt.zh: 最近的那面墙离相机多远？
prompt.en: How far from the camera is the nearest wall?

prompt.zh: 停着几辆车？
prompt.en: How many cars are parked?

prompt.zh: 画面里有行人吗？
prompt.en: Is there a pedestrian in the picture?

t.zh: 检查台旁边多了一个受控的小场景：一个物体、一架能绕着它转的相机和一盏灯。场景渲出的每张图，你都可以拿来和候选图比。
t.en: Beside the station there is now a small controlled scene: one object, a camera that orbits it and a lamp. Every picture the scene renders can be compared with the candidates.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：两张图的像素几乎都不同，拍的会是同一个物体吗？参照图拍的是场景里的物体；选出所有拍的也是它的候选图。
t.en: This level asks: when two pictures differ in almost every pixel, can they show the same object? The reference shows the object in the scene; choose every candidate that shows it too.

after.zh: 同一个物体换个视角、换盏灯，像素几乎全变，这叫<wiki-ref to="intra-class-variation"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: One object seen from another angle or under another light changes nearly every pixel: this is <wiki-ref to="intra-class-variation"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 转动场景的相机，选出拍的是参照图里那个物体的全部候选图。
brief.en: Turn the scene's camera, and choose every candidate that shows the object of the reference.

hint.zh: 别逐个比像素：转动相机，看场景能不能渲出和候选图一样的画面。
hint.en: Do not compare pixels one by one: turn the camera and see whether the scene can render the candidate's picture.

after.zh: 换了视角的图和参照图几乎没有一个像素相同，物体却没变。接下来动的是灯。
after.en: Pictures from another viewpoint share almost no pixel with the reference, yet the object is the same. Now the lamp moves.

prompt.zh: 哪几张图拍的是参照图里的物体？
prompt.en: Which pictures show the object of the reference?

prompt.zh: 这一组里，哪几张图拍的是参照图里的物体？
prompt.en: In this set, which pictures show the object of the reference?

brief.zh: 调动场景的灯，选出拍的是参照图里那个物体的全部候选图。
brief.en: Move the scene's lamp, and choose every candidate that shows the object of the reference.

hint.zh: 相机这次不动：明暗和影子变了，物体的形状变没变？
hint.en: The camera stays put this time: the shading and the shadows changed, but did the object's shape?

prompt.zh: 哪几张图拍的是参照图里的物体？

t.zh: 一个分类器的作者说：「它在任何背景下都认得出猫。」检查台拿到一批样例，每个样例有人工标注的真实类别和分类器的预测，还有预测的置信度。
t.en: The author of a classifier claims: 'it recognises a cat against any background.' The station receives a batch of cases, each with its labelled true class, the classifier's prediction and the confidence of that prediction.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：分类器在一张照片上答对了，而且很有把握，这能说明它换了背景也认得出吗？选出一个能推翻这句话的样例；一个也没有时，选「没有」。
t.en: This level asks: when a classifier gets one photo right, and confidently, does that show it will recognise the cat against other backgrounds? Choose a case that refutes the claim; when there is none, choose 'none'.

after.en: Staying reliable when irrelevant things about the input change is <wiki-ref to="robustness"></wiki-ref>: one right answer cannot prove it, one counterexample refutes it.

brief.zh: 选出能推翻「它在任何背景下都认得出猫」的样例；没有就选「没有」。

t.en: To test whether it is robust to irrelevant change, which cases belong in the set? Look at what each photo changes against the first: the viewpoint, the light, or something standing in front. The set you choose must cover all three changes.

hint.zh: 露出来的一角只说明那里有东西、是什么颜色；它后面还连着什么，图里没有。

title.en: A task for a rescue robot

t.zh: 检查台要正式上岗了：一台救援机器人在倒塌的楼里找人，找到一个就要靠过去。它的视觉系统交出什么、怎样检验、哪些问题一张图答不了，都由检查台来定。
t.en: The station goes to work: a rescue robot searches a collapsed building for people and must go to each one it finds. What its vision system hands in, how that is tested, and which questions one image cannot answer are the station's to settle.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：机器人要找到每个人并靠过去，它的视觉输出要包含什么，又该怎样检验？一共三步：选输出，配检验用的参照，再判断几句关于现场的话。
t.en: This level asks: a robot must find every person and go to them — what must its vision output contain, and how should it be tested? There are three steps: choose the outputs, pair them with references to test against, then judge statements about the site.

body.zh: 回答「哪些物体在哪里」：给每个物体一个类别和一个边界框。分类只给整张图一个或几个类别标签，不说位置；不带类别的框只说了在哪里，没说是什么；分割再把答案细化到每个像素。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲，视觉任务（幻灯片 7）。
body.en: Answers which objects are where: a class and a bounding box for each object. Classification gives the whole image one or a few class labels and says nothing about position; a box without a class says where but not what; segmentation refines the answer down to each pixel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1, vision tasks (slide 7).

body.zh: 给每个像素标出它属于哪一个具体物体（人-1、人-2）。语义分割只标出每个像素属于哪一类：同一类的几个物体挨在一起时连成一片，数不出个数；一个物体被挡成两块时，实例分割仍把两块标成同一个物体。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲（幻灯片 7、30）。
body.en: Labels each pixel with the particular object it belongs to (person-1, person-2). Semantic segmentation labels only each pixel's class: touching objects of one class merge into one region and cannot be counted; when an occluder cuts one object in two, instance segmentation still gives both pieces one id. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1 (slides 7, 30).

body.zh: 同一类、甚至同一个物体的照片，会因大小和距离、视角和姿态、光照、背景、遮挡而大不相同：几乎每个像素都变了，物体却没有变。所以识别不能靠记住像素，要找对这些无关变化有容忍度的表示。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲，识别为什么难（幻灯片 28）。
body.en: Photos of one class, even of one object, differ greatly with size and distance, viewpoint and pose, lighting, background and occlusion: nearly every pixel changes while the object does not. Recognition therefore cannot memorise pixels; it needs a representation tolerant of these irrelevant changes. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1, why recognition is hard (slide 28).

body.zh: 输入有无关的变化（视角、光照、背景，甚至只改了几个像素的对抗样本）时，输出仍然可靠。一次答对、哪怕置信度很高，也证明不了它；一个反例就能推翻「总能认出」，所以测试集要把每一种变化都覆盖到。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，对抗样本（幻灯片 2–3）。
body.en: A system's output stays reliable when irrelevant things about its input change (viewpoint, lighting, background, even the few altered pixels of an adversarial example). One correct answer, however confident, does not show it; one counterexample refutes 'it always recognises', so a test set must cover each kind of change. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2, adversarial examples (slides 2–3).

body.zh: 图形学由物体、材质、光照和相机正向生成图像，是正问题；视觉反过来从图像推回这些东西，是反问题。三维场景投成二维图像丢了一维信息，不同的场景能生成同一张图，所以单凭一张图，有些问题（物体多远、多大，挡住的是什么）没有唯一的答案。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲，视觉与图形学（幻灯片 8）。
body.en: Graphics generates an image forwards from objects, materials, lighting and camera: a forward problem. Vision infers them backwards from the image: an inverse problem. Projecting a 3D scene to a 2D image loses a dimension and different scenes can produce the same image, so from one image alone some questions (how far, how big, what is hidden) have no unique answer. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1, vision and graphics (slide 8).

t.zh: 距离固定以后，相机内部的像平面位置仍会影响投影。
t.en: With object depth fixed, the image plane position still affects the projection.

brief.zh: 调整像平面距离，让像高为 2。
brief.en: Adjust the image plane distance until the image height is 2.

why.zh: 这个设置没有达到目标。
why.en: This setting does not meet the goal.

brief.zh: 在另一组物体和距离下，让像高为 1.5。
brief.en: For another object and depth, make the image height 1.5.

why.zh: 这个设置没有达到目标。
why.en: This setting does not meet the goal.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 针孔相机已经能投影；同一物体距离改变时，像的大小也会变化。
t.en: The pinhole projects an object. Moving the same object changes its projected size.

brief.zh: 调整距离，让像高为 1。
brief.en: Adjust depth until the image height is 1.

why.zh: 这个设置没有达到目标。
why.en: This setting does not meet the goal.

brief.zh: 调整另一物体的距离，让像高为 1。
brief.en: Adjust the other object’s depth until its image height is 1.

why.zh: 这个设置没有达到目标。
why.en: This setting does not meet the goal.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 图像来自场景中的光。先用理想针孔观察一个点投到哪里。
t.en: An image comes from the scene. Start with an ideal pinhole and a single projected point.

brief.zh: 移动物点，使投影落在目标上。
brief.en: Move the point so its projection reaches the target.

why.zh: 这个设置没有达到目标。
why.en: This setting does not meet the goal.

brief.zh: 移动物点，使投影落在左侧的目标上。
brief.en: Move the point so its projection reaches the target on the left.

why.zh: 这个设置没有达到目标。
why.en: This setting does not meet the goal.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 两张图可以用不同方式改变。比较同一位置的数。
t.en: Two images can change in different ways. Compare values at each position.

brief.zh: 把每张图和变化方式配对。
brief.en: Match each image to the kind of change.

prompt.zh: 每格亮度都增加。
prompt.en: Both cells are brighter.

prompt.zh: 原来的两个值交换位置。
prompt.en: The original values exchange positions.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 灰度图只有一个值；彩色像素还要区分各通道。
t.en: A grey pixel has one value; a colour pixel has separate channels.

brief.zh: 把右边的像素设为蓝色 (0, 0, 1)。
brief.en: Set the pixel on the right to blue (0, 0, 1).
Set the lower-left pixel to (0.2, 0.7, 0.4).

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 图里的每格都有位置；交换两个方向会选中不同的格。
t.en: Each cell has a position; swapping the directions can select a different cell.

brief.zh: 选出坐标 (2, 0) 的像素。
brief.en: Select the pixel at (2, 0).

brief.zh: 写出高亮像素的坐标。
brief.en: Write the coordinates of the highlighted pixel.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 相机送来了一张小图。读出图里的数，才能检查后续的处理。
t.en: The camera has sent a small image. Read its values before processing it.

brief.zh: 把图中的值填入空格。
brief.en: Copy the values into the empty grid.

brief.zh: 填入另一张图的值。
brief.en: Copy the values of another image.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 这道题明确给出全部候选：屏后的物体在一个场景中是蓝色，在另一个场景中是绿色；两者的正面图相同。
t.en: For this puzzle the candidates are exhaustive: the object behind the screen is blue in one scene and green in the other, and both have the same front view.

brief.zh: 根据给出的候选场景判断每句话。
brief.en: Judge each claim against the candidate scenes.

hint.zh: 找出画面能排除和不能排除的情况。
hint.en: Consider which candidate scenes the picture can rule out.

prompt.zh: 立方体是红色的。
prompt.en: The cube is red.

prompt.zh: 屏后的物体在画面中可见。
prompt.en: The object behind the screen is visible.

prompt.zh: 屏后的物体是绿色的。
prompt.en: The object behind the screen is green.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 预测和参考答案必须描述同一种量，比较才有意义。
t.en: A prediction and a reference must describe the same quantity to be compared.

brief.zh: 为每项预测选择可比较的参考数据。
brief.en: Choose comparable reference data for each prediction.

hint.zh: 比较各项描述的量及其单位。
hint.en: Compare the quantity and its units.

prompt.zh: 预测类别
prompt.en: Predicted class

prompt.zh: 预测位置框
prompt.en: Predicted bounding box

prompt.zh: 预测距离
prompt.en: Predicted distance

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 有人声称：无论背景如何，机器的每次预测都正确。一条不符合的记录就足以反驳这句话。
t.en: A claim says every prediction remains correct regardless of background. One contrary record can refute it.

brief.zh: 选择能反驳这句话的记录。
brief.en: Choose a record that refutes the claim.

hint.zh: 对照每条记录的标注和预测。
hint.en: Compare the label and prediction in each record.

prompt.zh: 哪条记录反驳这句话？
prompt.en: Which record refutes the claim?

label.zh: 前景是猫，草地背景；预测为猫
label.en: Cat foreground, grass background; predicted cat

label.zh: 前景是猫，雪地背景；预测为狗
label.en: Cat foreground, snow background; predicted dog

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 预测是机器给出的答案；要知道它是否正确，还需要对应的标注。
t.en: A prediction is the machine’s answer; checking it requires the corresponding label.

brief.zh: 选择一条错误记录；没有错误时选择“没有错误”。
brief.en: Choose one erroneous record, or “No errors shown” if none is wrong.

hint.zh: 逐条对照预测和标注。
hint.en: Compare each prediction with its label.

prompt.zh: 哪条记录表明预测出错？
prompt.en: Which record shows an error?

prompt.zh: 哪条记录表明预测出错？
prompt.en: Which record shows an error?

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 参照图展示一个几何物体。为检查识别器是否能应对变化，需要挑选与参照图不同的测试图。
t.en: The reference image shows a geometric object. To test whether a recogniser handles changes, choose test images that differ from it.

brief.zh: 选择能覆盖所有指定变化的图片。
brief.en: Choose images covering every specified change.

hint.zh: 与参照图比较相机角度、受光方向和物体是否被遮挡。
hint.en: Compare the camera angle, direction of light, and occlusion with the reference.

prompt.zh: 选出的图片需要覆盖视角、光照和遮挡。
prompt.en: Choose images covering viewpoint, lighting and occlusion.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

t.zh: 同一结果有时能回答不止一个问题；有些量则不在结果里。
t.en: One output may answer more than one question, while some quantities are absent.

brief.zh: 每题至少选择一种足以回答问题的输出。
brief.en: For each question choose at least one output sufficient to answer it.

hint.zh: 检查结果是否包含问题要的量。
hint.en: Check whether the result contains the requested quantity.

prompt.zh: 指出属于物体的像素。
prompt.en: Identify the pixels belonging to the objects.

prompt.zh: 读取画面中心的距离。
prompt.en: Read the distance at the centre.

label.zh: 每个物体的类别和位置框
label.en: A class and box for each object

label.zh: 每个像素的类别和物体编号
label.en: A class and object ID per pixel

prompt.zh: 分开每个几何物体的像素。
prompt.en: Separate the pixels of individual geometric objects.

prompt.zh: 读取每个位置的距离。
prompt.en: Read distance at every position.

label.zh: 每个像素的类别和物体编号
label.en: A class and object ID per pixel

label.zh: 每个物体的类别和位置框
label.en: A class and box for each object

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

body.zh: 图上的一格：坐标 (x, y)，x 从左往右数，y 从上往下数，都从 0 起；灰度图一格一个数，彩色图一格三个数 [R, G, B]。
body.en: One cell of an image: at (x, y), x counted left to right and y top to bottom, both from 0; a grey image holds one number a cell, a colour image three, [R, G, B].

question.zh: 机器要回答什么？
question.en: What must the machine answer?

question.zh: 图像怎样形成和存储？
question.en: How are images formed and stored?

why: Chapter 1 from the new blueprint: the workbench's digital image, camera, colour and resampling levels and the zoom challenge

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一组数，这组数又怎样被裁剪、缩放和存下来？
question.en: How does a scene become an array of numbers, and how is that array cropped, resized and stored?

t.zh: 检查台判断得了答案，却碰不到图里的一个数。工作台从这里补起：相机把光变成数，计算机存下的就是这些数。这一章的灰度图里，0 是黑，1 是白，中间的数是不同深浅的灰。
t.en: The station could judge answers but could not touch a single number of an image. The workbench starts here: the camera turns light into numbers, and those numbers are what the computer stores. In this chapter's grey images 0 is black, 1 is white and the numbers between are shades of grey.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：相机拍下的这张小图，存进计算机是什么样子？照着画面把每个像素的数填进格子；格子摆成什么形状，图就存成什么形状。
t.en: This level asks: what does this small picture from the camera look like once it is stored in the computer? Following the picture, fill in each pixel's number; the shape of the grid is the shape the image is stored in.

after.zh: 灰度图存成 高 × 宽 的<wiki-ref to="image-array"></wiki-ref>，彩色图每格存三个数。
after.en: A grey image is stored as a height × width <wiki-ref to="image-array"></wiki-ref>; a colour image holds three numbers a cell.

brief.zh: 照着画面，把这张 3 像素宽、2 像素高的灰度图存成一格格的数。
brief.en: Following the picture, store this grey image, 3 pixels wide and 2 high, as cells of numbers.

hint.zh: 画面里只有三种颜色：黑、中灰、白。
hint.en: The picture holds only three shades: black, mid grey and white.

brief.zh: 再存一张 2 像素宽、3 像素高的灰度图。
brief.en: Now store a grey image 2 pixels wide and 3 high.

hint.zh: 画面里的一行像素，存成格子里的哪一行？
hint.en: Which row of the grid does a row of pixels in the picture go to?

t.zh: 彩色图的每个像素存三个数 (R, G, B)：红、绿、蓝各有多亮，各在 0 到 1 之间。
t.en: Each pixel of a colour image stores three numbers (R, G, B): how bright its red, green and blue are, each from 0 to 1.

brief.zh: 把第二行正中间那个像素改成纯蓝，别的格子不动。
brief.en: Turn the middle pixel of the second row pure blue, leaving every other cell as it is.

hint.zh: 纯蓝：蓝色最亮，红和绿一点也没有。
hint.en: Pure blue: the blue at its brightest, no red and no green at all.

t.zh: 要读写一个像素，先得说清是哪一个。工作台给图上的每一格一对坐标 (x, y)，格子旁边画着两条坐标轴。
t.en: To read or write a pixel one must first say which. The workbench gives every cell of an image a pair of coordinates (x, y), and draws the two axes beside the grid.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图像坐标 (x, y) 指的是哪一个像素？对着坐标轴点出给定坐标的格子，再反过来写出高亮格子的坐标。
t.en: This level asks: which pixel do image coordinates (x, y) refer to? Reading the axes, pick the cell at given coordinates, then go the other way and write the coordinates of a highlighted cell.

after.zh: 这就是<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinates"></wiki-ref>：原点在左上角，从 0 数起。
after.en: These are <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinates"></wiki-ref>: the origin at the top-left corner, counting from 0.

brief.zh: 点出坐标 (0, 1) 的像素。
brief.en: Pick the pixel at coordinates (0, 1).

hint.zh: 先看坐标轴上 0 在哪个角，y 往哪个方向增大。
hint.en: First see which corner the axes start at, and which way y grows.

brief.zh: 在这张宽高不等的图上点出 (2, 0)。
brief.en: On this image, whose width and height differ, pick (2, 0).

brief.zh: 写出高亮像素的坐标 (x, y)。
brief.en: Write the coordinates (x, y) of the highlighted pixel.

hint.zh: x 数的是第几列，y 数的是第几行。
hint.en: x counts the column, y the row.

t.zh: 程序里读像素用的是数组下标 I[第几行, 第几列]，不是坐标 (x, y)。两种写法说的是同一批像素，顺序却不一样。
t.en: A program reads a pixel by its array index I[row, column], not by coordinates (x, y). The two name the same pixels, in a different order.

t.zh: 这一关从坐标换到数组：按下标点出像素，再从数组的形状读出图的宽和高。库里还有第三种写法：OpenCV 把尺寸写成 (宽, 高)。
t.en: This level moves from coordinates to arrays: pick pixels by index, then read an image's width and height off its array shape. Libraries add a third way of writing it: OpenCV gives a size as (width, height).

brief.zh: 点出数组元素 I[1, 2] 所在的像素。
brief.en: Pick the pixel that holds the array element I[1, 2].

hint.zh: 这张图只有 2 行。
hint.en: This image has only 2 rows.

brief.zh: 这张图的数组形状是 (2, 3)：写出它的宽和高。
brief.en: This image's array shape is (2, 3): write its width and height.

brief.zh: OpenCV 说这张图的尺寸是 (4, 5)：写出它的数组形状。
brief.en: OpenCV gives this image's size as (4, 5): write its array shape.

hint.zh: 数组的形状先写哪一维？OpenCV 的尺寸先写哪一维？
hint.en: Which dimension does an array shape list first? Which does an OpenCV size list first?

t.zh: 图里的数从哪里来？工作台先装上相机台：一台理想的针孔相机。场景里一点射出的光穿过针孔，落在离针孔 f 的像平面上。台上把像平面画在针孔前面，像是正的。
t.en: Where do an image's numbers come from? The workbench first gets a camera bench: an ideal pinhole camera. Light from a point of the scene passes through the hole and lands on the image plane at distance f from it. The bench draws the plane in front of the hole, so the image is upright.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一点穿过针孔，落在像平面的什么位置？同一个物体离得越远，像怎样变？每一步只有一个旋钮能动，让像落到圆圈标出的目标上。
t.en: This level asks: where on the image plane does a point land after passing the hole? How does the image change as the object moves away? Each step opens one knob; bring the image onto the circled target.

after.zh: 这就是<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>：像的位置和大小都随 f/Z 缩放。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>: where the image lands and how big it is both scale with f/Z.

brief.zh: f = 2、Z = 4：横向移动这一点，让它的像落在 u = 1 的标记上。
brief.en: With f = 2 and Z = 4, move the point sideways so its image lands on the mark at u = 1.

hint.zh: 顺着画出的光线看：它从物体出发，穿过针孔，停在像平面上。
hint.en: Follow the drawn ray: it leaves the object, passes the hole and stops on the image plane.

why.zh: 把物体放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：像不在物体的高度上，它按 f/Z 缩小了。
why.en: With the point at X = 1 its image lands only at u = 0.5: the image is not at the object's height, it is shrunk by f/Z.

brief.zh: 箭高 2、f = 2：只前后移动这支箭，让像高等于 0.5。
brief.en: An arrow 2 tall, f = 2: move the arrow only in depth so its image is 0.5 tall.

hint.zh: 先看箭在 Z = 2 和 Z = 4 时，像各有多高。
hint.en: First see how tall the image is with the arrow at Z = 2 and at Z = 4.

why.zh: 以为距离每加 1，像高就少同样一截：像高按 1/Z 变化，Z = 5 时是 0.8。
why.en: Assuming each unit of depth takes the same amount off the image: the height goes as 1/Z, and at Z = 5 it is 0.8.

t.zh: 在针孔相机上，像的大小靠移动物体来改。这一关物体和它的距离都锁住了：物体不动、相机不挪，还有什么能让像变大？
t.en: On the pinhole camera the image size was changed by moving the object. Here the object and its distance are locked: with neither the object nor the camera moving, what else can make the image larger?

t.zh: 台上只有像平面的距离 f 能动。先在台上让像高达到目标，再对另外两组数不上台、先算出 f。
t.en: Only the plane distance f turns on the bench. First bring the image to the target height there, then, for two other sets of numbers, work out f without the bench.

brief.zh: 物高 1、距离 4 都固定：只调像平面距离 f，让像高等于 1。
brief.en: Object height 1 and depth 4 are fixed: adjust only the plane distance f so the image is 1 tall.

why.zh: 以为像平面挪近，像会变大：f 越短，光线越早落到像平面上，像越小。
why.en: Assuming a nearer plane gives a larger image: the shorter f, the sooner the rays meet the plane and the smaller the image.

brief.zh: 不上台，先算：每组数要把像平面放在多远？
brief.en: Without the bench, work it out: how far must the plane stand for each set?

hint.zh: 像高、物高、距离和 f 之间的比例，在台上已经看到过。
hint.en: The bench has already shown how image height, object height, depth and f relate.

prompt.zh: 物高 1.5、距离 6，要像高 1：f 是多少？
prompt.en: Height 1.5, depth 6, image height wanted 1: what is f?

prompt.zh: 物高 2、距离 10，要像高 0.5：f 是多少？
prompt.en: Height 2, depth 10, image height wanted 0.5: what is f?

t.zh: 相机台上，同一个像高可以来自不同的物体。焦距 f = 2 固定。这一关的问题是：看到像有多高，能定出物体有多远吗？从几组（物高, 距离）里，选出像高都是 1、距离却各不相同的几组。
t.en: On the camera bench one image height can come from different objects. The focal length is fixed at f = 2. This level asks: does the height of an image tell how far away the object is? From several (height, depth) pairs, choose those that all image 1 tall at different depths.

brief.zh: f = 2：选出像高都是 1、距离各不相同的两组以上。
brief.en: With f = 2, choose two or more pairs that all image 1 tall, each at its own depth.

hint.zh: 物高和距离一起翻倍时，像高怎样变？
hint.en: When height and depth double together, what happens to the image height?

prompt.zh: 哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: Which pairs all image 1 tall at different depths?

prompt.zh: 换一批：哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: A new batch: which pairs all image 1 tall at different depths?

t.zh: 针孔小，进来的光少，图很暗；把孔开大，同一点的光会落到传感器上不同的地方。工作台换上一块焦距 50 mm 的透镜：光圈直径 A 管进来多少光，对焦距离管透镜把哪个距离上的光会聚到一点。
t.en: A small pinhole lets in little light and the image is dark; widen it, and light from one point lands at different places on the sensor. The workbench now holds a 50 mm lens: the aperture diameter A sets how much light comes in, the focus distance which depth the lens gathers back to a point.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：要让图更亮又不变糊，只把孔开大够吗？进光量至少要到 4，近处的箱子还要清晰：它在传感器上的模糊圈不超过 0.03 mm。
t.en: This level asks: to make the image brighter without blurring it, is widening the hole enough? The light must reach at least 4, and the near crate must be sharp: its blur circle on the sensor no wider than 0.03 mm.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="lens"></wiki-ref>只把一个距离上的光会聚到一点，别的距离成模糊圈。
after.en: A <wiki-ref to="lens"></wiki-ref> gathers the light of one depth to a point; other depths make blur circles.

brief.zh: 调光圈和对焦距离：进光量不低于 4，近处的箱子清晰。
brief.en: Set the aperture and the focus distance: light at least 4, and the near crate sharp.

hint.zh: 光圈开大以后，看两个物体的模糊圈；再看对焦距离改变的是哪一个。
hint.en: After opening the aperture, watch both objects' blur circles; then see which one the focus distance changes.

why.zh: 只把光圈开大：光够了，可箱子不在对焦距离上，它的模糊圈随光圈一起变大。
why.en: Only opening the aperture: the light is enough, but the crate is not at the focus distance and its blur circle grows with the aperture.

why.zh: 只对焦、不开光圈：箱子清晰了，进光量仍然只有 0.16。
why.en: Only focusing, aperture unchanged: the crate is sharp, but the light is still only 0.16.

t.zh: 透镜对焦在 1500 mm，近处的标记在 1200 mm，远处的在 2000 mm。光圈这回用摄影的写法给出：f 数是焦距除以光圈直径，50 mm 镜头的 f/2 就是 25 mm 的光圈。
t.en: The lens is focused at 1500 mm, with the near marker at 1200 mm and the far one at 2000 mm. The aperture is now given the photographer's way: the f-number is the focal length over the aperture diameter, so f/2 on a 50 mm lens is a 25 mm aperture.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：近处和远处两个物体，怎样在一张照片里都清晰？曲线画出每个深度的模糊圈和清晰的门槛；进光量也不能低于 1。
t.en: This level asks: how can a near and a far object both be sharp in one photo? The curve draws each depth's blur circle against the sharpness threshold; and the light must not fall below 1.

after.zh: 同时清晰的深度范围叫<wiki-ref to="depth-of-field"></wiki-ref>：f 数越大，光圈越小，它越深。
after.en: The range of depths sharp at once is the <wiki-ref to="depth-of-field"></wiki-ref>: the larger the f-number, the smaller the aperture and the deeper it is.

brief.zh: 对焦不动，选一档光圈：两个标记都清晰，进光量不低于 1。
brief.en: With the focus fixed, choose an aperture: both markers sharp and the light at least 1.

hint.zh: 比较两档光圈下，曲线低于门槛的那一段有多宽。
hint.en: Compare how wide the stretch of the curve below the threshold is at two apertures.

why.zh: 为了亮把光圈开到最大：清晰范围收窄到对焦处附近，两个标记都落在范围外。
why.en: Opening the aperture fully for light: the sharp range narrows around the focus and both markers fall outside it.

why.zh: 光圈收到最小：两个标记都清晰了，进光量却只剩约 0.27。
why.en: Closing the aperture all the way: both markers are sharp, but the light drops to about 0.27.

title.en: Sharp front to back, and bright enough

t.zh: 两个物体在 1000 mm 和 3000 mm，两个都要清晰，进光量又不能低于 1。这回光圈和对焦距离都能动。这一关的问题是：既要两个深度都清晰，又要足够的光，对焦该放在哪里？
t.en: Two objects stand at 1000 mm and 3000 mm; both must be sharp and the light must not fall below 1. This time the aperture and the focus distance both turn. This level asks: with both depths to keep sharp and enough light to gather, where should the focus go?

brief.zh: 同时调光圈和对焦距离：两个物体都清晰，进光量不低于 1。
brief.en: Set the aperture and the focus together: both objects sharp and the light at least 1.

hint.zh: 清晰范围在对焦距离的两边都有：只用上一边，另一边就白白浪费了。
hint.en: The sharp range extends on both sides of the focus: use only one side and the other is wasted.

why.zh: 对焦在近处，再收光圈直到两个都清晰：进光量只剩 0.25。
why.en: Focusing on the near object and closing down until both are sharp: the light is only 0.25.

why.zh: 光够了，对焦却还在近处：远处的门糊了。
why.en: The light is enough, but the focus is still on the near object: the far door blurs.

why.zh: 对焦挪到远处：近处的人又糊了。
why.en: Moving the focus to the far object: now the near person blurs.

t.zh: 像平面不是无限大的：相机台装上一块 20 mm 高、200 像素的传感器，主点在中心。像落到传感器边外的物体，不在画面里。
t.en: The image plane is not endless: the camera bench now holds a sensor 20 mm and 200 pixels tall, its principal point at the centre. An object whose image falls past its edges is out of the picture.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：要把一排物体全拍进画面，焦距该变长还是变短？传感器大小不变，物体都在 2000 mm 外，台上只有焦距 f 能动。
t.en: This level asks: to get a whole row of objects into the frame, should the focal length grow or shrink? The sensor stays as it is, the objects stand 2000 mm away, and only the focal length f turns.

after.zh: 焦距决定看得多宽，这就是<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>：焦距越短，看得越宽。
after.en: The focal length decides how wide the camera sees: its <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>. The shorter the focal length, the wider.

brief.zh: 调焦距，让三支箭的像都落在传感器上。
brief.en: Set the focal length so all three arrows image on the sensor.

hint.zh: 看两端那两支箭的像落在哪里，传感器的边又在哪里。
hint.en: See where the two outer arrows image, and where the sensor's edges are.

why.zh: 把焦距拉长想看清楚些：每支箭都变大，两端的落到了传感器外面。
why.en: Lengthening the focal length to see better: every arrow grows, and the outer ones fall off the sensor.

brief.zh: 只拍中间那支箭：调焦距，让它的像占到画面高度的 95% 以上，又不出画面。
brief.en: Only the middle arrow now: set the focal length so its image fills at least 95% of the frame's height without leaving it.

hint.zh: 台上读得出视场：焦距变了，它往哪边变？
hint.en: The bench reads out the field of view: which way does it move as the focal length changes?

why.zh: 缩短焦距：视场变宽，这支箭只占画面的一小截。
why.en: Shortening the focal length: the view widens and the arrow covers only a sliver of the frame.

why.zh: 焦距拉得过长：箭的像比传感器还高，上下都出了画面。
why.en: A focal length too long: the arrow's image is taller than the sensor and leaves the frame at both ends.

t.zh: 图里的长度以像素计，像平面上的长度以毫米计。传感器把两者连起来：它高 20 mm，排着 200 个像素。
t.en: Lengths in the image are counted in pixels, lengths on the image plane in millimetres. The sensor links the two: it is 20 mm tall and holds 200 pixels.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：物体在图里高 100 像素，实高 120 mm，离相机 600 mm，镜头的焦距是多少毫米？先算，再到相机台上验证，最后写出以像素计的焦距。
t.en: This level asks: an object is 100 pixels tall in the image, 120 mm tall and 600 mm from the camera — what is the lens's focal length in millimetres? Work it out, check it on the camera bench, then state the focal length in pixels.

after.zh: 焦距除以像素尺寸，就是<wiki-ref to="pixel-units"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: The focal length divided by the pixel size is the <wiki-ref to="pixel-units"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 由像素高、实高和距离，算出镜头的焦距（毫米）。
brief.en: From the height in pixels, the real height and the distance, work out the lens's focal length in millimetres.

hint.zh: 相似三角形两边的长度要用同一种单位。
hint.en: Both sides of the similar triangles must be in one unit.

prompt.zh: 图里高 100 像素，实高 120 mm，距离 600 mm：焦距多少毫米？
prompt.en: 100 pixels tall in the image, 120 mm tall, 600 mm away: how many millimetres is f?

prompt.zh: 图里高 80 像素，实高 400 mm，距离 2000 mm：焦距多少毫米？
prompt.en: 80 pixels tall in the image, 400 mm tall, 2000 mm away: how many millimetres is f?

brief.zh: 物高 120 mm、距离 600 mm：调焦距，让像在图里高 100 像素。
brief.en: Object 120 mm tall, 600 mm away: set the focal length so the image is 100 pixels tall.

why.zh: 把 100 像素当成 100 mm 代进比例：像高 100 mm，比整块 20 mm 的传感器还高。
why.en: Putting 100 pixels into the ratio as 100 mm: the image is 100 mm tall, taller than the whole 20 mm sensor.

brief.zh: 这台相机 f = 50 mm，每个像素 0.1 mm：写出它以像素计的焦距和竖直方向的视场。
brief.en: This camera has f = 50 mm and 0.1 mm pixels: give its focal length in pixels and its vertical field of view.

prompt.zh: 以像素计的焦距是多少？
prompt.en: What is the focal length in pixels?

prompt.zh: 竖直方向的视场大约多宽？
prompt.en: About how wide is the vertical field of view?

t.zh: 一张用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，在这里显示出来，蓝天却成了橙色。这一关的问题是：同一张照片，为什么在这里显示出橙色的天空？
t.en: A photo read in with OpenCV is displayed here, and its blue sky has turned orange. This level asks: why does the same photo show an orange sky here?

t.zh: 工作台第一次接电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去。新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>取出彩色图的第 c 个通道，<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图合成一张彩色图；通道编号 0、1、2 作为输入摆在板上。
t.en: The workbench wires its first circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right. The new part <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref> takes channel c out of a colour image, and <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images one colour image; the channel numbers 0, 1 and 2 are on the board as inputs.

after.zh: 各个库的<wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>不同：OpenCV 读图得到 BGR，Matplotlib 按 RGB 显示。
after.en: Libraries differ in <wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>: OpenCV reads images as BGR, Matplotlib displays RGB.

brief.zh: 输入是按 BGR 存的照片：交出同一张照片按 RGB 存的样子。
brief.en: The input is a photo stored as BGR: give the same photo stored as RGB.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个通道分别取出来看：天空的蓝在哪一个里？
hint.en: Take the three channels out one by one: which holds the sky's blue?

t.zh: 电路算出的值可以落在 [0, 1] 之外。屏幕只显示得出 0 到 1，画的时候超出的部分画成最黑或最白。
t.en: A circuit may compute values outside [0, 1]. A screen shows only 0 to 1, and draws whatever lies beyond as the darkest or the brightest.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：两个像素看上去一样白，存着的数一样吗？先填出每格显示出来的值，再把 OpenCV 读进来的 uint8 像素换成 [0, 1] 里的 (R, G, B)。uint8 是 0 到 255 的整数，255 最亮。
t.en: This level asks: when two pixels look equally white, do they hold the same number? First fill in each cell's displayed value, then turn uint8 pixels read by OpenCV into (R, G, B) in [0, 1]. A uint8 is a whole number from 0 to 255, 255 the brightest.

after.zh: 像素值有<wiki-ref to="value-range"></wiki-ref>和类型：显示时截到两端，存着的数不变。
after.en: Pixel values have a <wiki-ref to="value-range"></wiki-ref> and a type: the display clips to the ends, the stored numbers stay.

brief.zh: 对照每格存着的数，填出它在屏幕上显示出来的值。
brief.en: From each cell's stored number, fill in the value the screen displays.

hint.zh: 看画面里最白的几格：它们存的数都一样吗？
hint.en: Look at the whitest cells of the picture: do they all hold the same number?

brief.zh: 这两个像素是 OpenCV 读进来的 uint8 值：写成 [0, 1] 里的 (R, G, B)。
brief.en: These two pixels are uint8 values read by OpenCV: write them as (R, G, B) in [0, 1].

hint.zh: OpenCV 读进来的三个数按什么顺序排？
hint.en: In what order does OpenCV store the three numbers?

t.zh: 工作台要能缩放图像。和取出一部分不同，缩放要给新图的每个像素算出一个值；在算值之前，先得知道它落在原图的什么位置。
t.en: The workbench must resize images. Unlike taking out a part, resizing computes a value for every pixel of the new image; before any value, each new pixel needs its position in the original.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图像放大或缩小时，新图的每个像素对应原图的什么位置？约定是新旧两排像素的中心对齐，两排一样长。先在格子上手算一行，再搭一块电路。
t.en: This level asks: when an image is enlarged or shrunk, where in the original does each new pixel sit? The convention: the two rows of pixels are equally long and their centres are aligned. First work out one row by hand on the grid, then wire a circuit.

desc.zh: 输入原图的宽 sw、高 sh 和新图的宽 nw、高 nh，输出新图每个像素在原图里的 x、y（两张坐标图）
desc.en: Takes the original's width sw and height sh and the new width nw and height nh; gives each new pixel's x and y in the original (two coordinate images)

after.zh: 这就是<wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>：新图的每个像素反向映射回原图。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>: every pixel of the new image mapped back into the original.

brief.zh: 这一行 2 像素宽，放大成 3 像素：写出每个新像素在原图里的 x。
brief.en: This row, 2 pixels wide, is enlarged to 3: write where each new pixel sits in the original, as x.

hint.zh: 把新旧两排画成等长的两条，各自的像素中心落在哪里？
hint.en: Draw the two rows as two bars of one length: where does each pixel centre fall?

after.zh: 新像素不是旧像素换了编号：中间那个落在两个旧像素之间。
after.en: New pixels are not old ones renumbered: the middle one falls between two old pixels.

label.zh: 新像素在原图里的 x

t.zh: 手算一行可以，一整张图就要电路了。新元件：<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>（给定宽高，给出每格就是自己 x、y 的两张图），以及<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>，它们对数和整张图逐个值地算。
t.en: One row by hand is fine; a whole image needs a circuit. New parts: <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>, <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref> (for a width and height, the two images whose cells hold their own x and y), and <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>, <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>, which work value by value on numbers and whole images.

brief.zh: 输入原图和新图的宽高：交出新图每个像素在原图里的 x 坐标图和 y 坐标图。
brief.en: Given the original's and the new width and height, give the image of each new pixel's x in the original, and the image of its y.

hint.zh: 先给新图的每个像素一对它自己的坐标。
hint.en: First give every pixel of the new image its own pair of coordinates.

hint.zh: 新图的一个像素宽，相当于原图的几个像素宽？像素中心和像素左边差多少？
hint.en: One pixel of the new image is how many pixels of the original wide? How far is a pixel's centre from its left edge?

t.zh: 有了采样网格，每个新像素都知道自己落在原图的哪里；可这个位置一般不是整数，原图在那里没有像素。
t.en: With the sampling grid every new pixel knows where it sits in the original; but that position is seldom a whole number, and the original has no pixel there.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：放大一张图时，落在两个旧像素之间的新像素，值从哪里来？新元件<part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref>读出图的宽高，<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>按整数坐标在图上取值，<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>向下取整。离两边一样远时，约定取坐标较大的一边。
t.en: This level asks: when an image is enlarged, where does a new pixel that falls between two old ones get its value? New parts: <part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref> reads an image's width and height, <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads an image at whole-number coordinates, <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds down. When a position is equally far from two pixels, the convention takes the larger coordinate.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽 w、高 h，输出缩放后的图：每个新像素取原图里离它最近的像素
desc.en: Takes an image and a new width w and height h; gives the resized image, each new pixel the original pixel nearest to it

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour"></wiki-ref>：放大后一块一块的，OpenCV 里叫 INTER_NEAREST。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour"></wiki-ref>: enlargements come out in squares; OpenCV calls it INTER_NEAREST.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，每个新像素照抄原图里离它最近的那个像素。
brief.en: Given an image and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel copying the original pixel nearest to it.

hint.zh: 取像素只接受整数坐标，也不接受原图外面的坐标。
hint.en: The lookup takes only whole-number coordinates, and none outside the image.

hint.zh: 离一个坐标最近的整数，和它向下取整得到的整数，什么时候不一样？
hint.en: When does the whole number nearest a coordinate differ from the one rounding down gives?

t.zh: 最近邻缩放放大时成块。这一关换一个方向：最近邻缩小图像时，没被选中的旧像素去了哪里？先把条纹图缩到一半宽，同时交出每个新像素的采样位置，再判断原图的哪些列留在了结果里。
t.en: Nearest-neighbour enlarging makes squares. This level goes the other way: when nearest neighbour shrinks an image, what becomes of the old pixels it does not pick? First shrink striped images to half their width, giving each new pixel's sample position as well, then judge which of the original's columns survive.

brief.zh: 把输入的图缩到一半宽（高不变），并交出每个新像素在原图里的 x。
brief.en: Shrink the input to half its width (height unchanged), and give each new pixel's x in the original.

brief.zh: 选出值留在了缩小结果里的那些原图列。
brief.en: Choose the original columns whose values survive in the shrunk result.

hint.zh: 每个新像素只读原图的一列。
hint.en: Each new pixel reads one column of the original.

prompt.zh: 这一行 8 像素宽，最近邻缩到 4 像素：哪几列的值留了下来？
prompt.en: This row, 8 pixels wide, is shrunk to 4 by nearest neighbour: which columns' values survive?

prompt.zh: 这一行 9 像素宽，最近邻缩到 3 像素：哪几列的值留了下来？
prompt.en: This row, 9 pixels wide, is shrunk to 3 by nearest neighbour: which columns' values survive?

t.zh: 最近邻缩放只会照抄，新像素的值只能是原图里已有的某一个。这一关的问题是：新像素落在两个旧像素之间时，它只能等于其中一个吗？这一关的图都只有一行。
t.en: Nearest-neighbour resizing only copies: a new pixel can only take a value the original already has. This level asks: when a new pixel falls between two old ones, must it equal one of them? This level's images are all one row high.

t.zh: 测试要的是：[0, 1] 放大成 3 像素时，中间那个是 0.5。新像素的值由它左右两个旧像素决定，离得越近的那个说了算的越多。
t.en: The tests want [0, 1] enlarged to 3 pixels to have 0.5 in the middle. A new pixel's value is decided by the old pixels on its left and right, the nearer one counting for more.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽 w、高 h，输出缩放后的图：每个新像素由左右两个旧像素按距离加权
desc.en: Takes an image and a new width w and height h; gives the resized image, each new pixel weighted from the old pixels to its left and right by distance

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：权重之和为 1，新值介于两边之间。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: the weights sum to 1 and the new value lies between the two.

brief.zh: 输入一行像素和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，新像素由左右两个旧像素按距离加权。
brief.en: Given a row of pixels and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel weighted from its two old neighbours by distance.

hint.zh: 先找出新位置左边那个旧像素，再算新位置离它有多远。
hint.en: First find the old pixel to the left of the new position, then how far the position is from it.

hint.zh: 两端的新位置落在原图之外：取像素可以设成取最近的边。
hint.en: The new positions at the ends fall outside the original: the lookup can be set to read the nearest edge.

t.zh: 线性缩放只沿一行插值，竖直方向照抄离得最近的那一行。这一关的问题是：在二维图像里，落在四个旧像素中间的新像素，值怎么算？
t.en: Linear resizing interpolates only along a row and copies the nearest row vertically. This level asks: in a 2D image, how is the value of a new pixel among four old ones computed?

t.zh: 先用手上的线性缩放只改一张图的宽度，看它在每一行上做了什么；再把这块元件升级：新像素由周围四个旧像素加权。
t.en: First use the linear resizer in hand to change only an image's width, and see what it does on each row; then upgrade the part: a new pixel weighted from the four old pixels around it.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽 w、高 h，输出缩放后的图：每个新像素由周围四个旧像素按距离加权（双线性）
desc.en: Takes an image and a new width w and height h; gives the resized image, each new pixel weighted from the four old pixels around it by distance (bilinear)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：四个权重之和为 1，OpenCV 里叫 INTER_LINEAR。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: four weights summing to 1; OpenCV calls it INTER_LINEAR.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽：交出只改了宽度、高度不变的图。
brief.en: Given an image and a new width, give the image with only its width changed, its height as it was.

after.zh: 每一行各自沿 x 插值，行和行之间没有混合。
after.en: Each row is interpolated along x on its own; rows are never mixed.

brief.zh: 升级线性缩放：输入一张图和新的宽、高，新像素由周围四个旧像素按距离加权。
brief.en: Upgrade the linear resize: given an image and a new width and height, each new pixel weighted from the four old pixels around it by distance.

hint.zh: 竖直方向也有一个距离：新位置离上面那一行有多远。
hint.en: There is a vertical distance too: how far the new position is from the row above.

hint.zh: 上下两行各沿 x 插一次，得到两个值，再在它们之间沿 y 插一次。
hint.en: Interpolate along x on the row above and on the row below, then along y between the two results.

t.zh: 手上有两种缩放：最近邻和双线性。这一关的问题是：用它们放大同一张图，结果差在哪里？是不是总有一种更好？先并排放大，再把结果认到剖面上，最后判断一句论断。
t.en: Two resizers are in hand: nearest neighbour and bilinear. This level asks: enlarging one image with each, how do the results differ, and is one always better? Enlarge side by side, match the results to profiles, then judge a claim.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽、高：交出最近邻和双线性各自缩放的结果。
brief.en: Given an image and a new width and height, give the nearest-neighbour and the bilinear results.

brief.zh: 为两种放大的结果各选出它的剖面。
brief.en: For each of the two enlargements, choose its profile.

prompt.zh: [0, 1] 用最近邻放大到 5 像素
prompt.en: [0, 1] enlarged to 5 pixels by nearest neighbour

prompt.zh: [0, 1] 用双线性放大到 5 像素
prompt.en: [0, 1] enlarged to 5 pixels by bilinear

prompt.zh: [0, 0, 1, 1] 用双线性放大到 8 像素
prompt.en: [0, 0, 1, 1] enlarged to 8 pixels by bilinear

prompt.zh: [0, 0, 1, 1] 用最近邻放大到 8 像素
prompt.en: [0, 0, 1, 1] enlarged to 8 pixels by nearest neighbour

brief.zh: 选出说明「双线性总比最近邻好」不成立的那组结果。
brief.en: Choose the result that shows 'bilinear is always better than nearest neighbour' does not hold.

hint.zh: 有的图里，每个值都有固定的含义，两者之间的值没有意义。
hint.en: In some images every value has a fixed meaning, and values in between mean nothing.

prompt.zh: 哪一组结果是反例？
prompt.en: Which result is a counterexample?

label.en: a segmentation label map (0 background, 1 object) [0, 1], bilinear: [0, 0.25, 0.75, 1]

prompt.zh: 这一批里，哪一组结果是反例？
prompt.en: In this batch, which result is a counterexample?

label.en: a class id map (1 road, 3 pedestrian) [1, 3], bilinear: [1, 1.5, 2.5, 3]

t.zh: 图像存进文件时，每个值只能取有限的几级：uint8 有 256 级。电路算出来的值还可能越出 [0, 1]。
t.en: When an image is stored, each value can take only a few levels: uint8 has 256. And values a circuit computes may leave [0, 1].

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个值只能存成 L 级中的一级时，该存哪一级？L 级把 [0, 1] 等分，L = 3 时是 0、0.5、1。新元件<part-ref to="part:min"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="part:max"></part-ref>逐个值取两者中小的、大的。正好在两级中间时，约定取较大的一级。
t.en: This level asks: when a value can only be stored as one of L levels, which should it be? L levels divide [0, 1] evenly: with L = 3 they are 0, 0.5 and 1. The new parts <part-ref to="part:min"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:max"></part-ref> take the smaller and the larger of two, value by value. A value exactly between two levels goes to the larger, by convention.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和级数 L，输出量化后的图：先截到 [0, 1]，再存成最近的一级
desc.en: Takes an image and a number of levels L; gives the quantised image: clipped to [0, 1], then stored as the nearest level

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="quantisation"></wiki-ref>：uint8 就是 256 级的量化。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="quantisation"></wiki-ref>: uint8 is quantisation to 256 levels.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和级数 L：截到 [0, 1] 以后，每个值存成离它最近的一级。
brief.en: Given an image and a number of levels L, clip to [0, 1], then store each value as the level nearest to it.

hint.zh: 乘上 L − 1 以后，每一级正好落在一个整数上。
hint.en: Multiplied by L − 1, every level lands on a whole number.

hint.zh: −0.2 和 1.3 这样的值会算出不存在的级。
hint.en: Values such as −0.2 and 1.3 give levels that do not exist.

t.zh: 量化器把每个值存成最近的一级。这一关的问题是：量化以后，原来的值还能找回来吗？先让量化器存一张图，同时交出每个值被改了多少；再反过来，从几组输入里找出存成同一个结果的那些。
t.en: The quantiser stores each value as the nearest level. This level asks: after quantisation, can the original values be recovered? First have the quantiser store an image and give how much each value was changed; then go backwards and find, among several inputs, those stored as one same result.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和级数 L：交出量化的结果，以及原值减去结果的差。
brief.en: Given an image and a number of levels L, give the quantised result and the original minus the result.

brief.zh: 选出量化以后和给出的结果完全相同的全部输入。
brief.en: Choose every input whose quantised result is exactly the one given.

hint.zh: 把每组输入逐个值算一遍，看它存成哪一级。
hint.en: Work each input through value by value, and see which level it is stored as.

prompt.zh: 存成 3 级以后得到 [0, 0.5] 的输入有哪些？
prompt.en: Which inputs become [0, 0.5] when stored in 3 levels?

prompt.zh: 存成 2 级以后得到 [0, 1] 的输入有哪些？
prompt.en: Which inputs become [0, 1] when stored in 2 levels?

t.zh: 流水线常常只要图里的一部分。这一关的问题是：从一张图里取出一块时，输出的像素值是原图里已有的，还是新算出来的？输入一张图、窗口左上角的 x0、y0 和窗口的宽 w、高 h。
t.en: A pipeline often wants only part of an image. This level asks: when a region is taken out of an image, are the output's pixel values ones the original holds, or newly computed? The inputs are an image, the window's top-left x0, y0, and its width w and height h.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、窗口左上角 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h，输出窗口里的像素，值原样不变
desc.en: Takes an image, a window's top-left x0, y0 and its width w and height h; gives the pixels inside the window, values unchanged

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="cropping"></wiki-ref>：NumPy 写成 image[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w]。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="cropping"></wiki-ref>: in NumPy, image[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w].

brief.zh: 输入一张图、窗口左上角 (x0, y0) 和宽 w、高 h：交出窗口里的像素。
brief.en: Given an image, a window's top-left corner (x0, y0) and its width w and height h, give the pixels inside the window.

hint.zh: 窗口里坐标 (x, y) 的像素，是原图里的哪一个？
hint.en: Which pixel of the original is the window's pixel at (x, y)?

t.zh: 识别网络要 S×S 的输入，照片却有各种宽高。这一关的问题是：网络要 512×512，手里是 768×512 的照片，直接缩放到 512×512 可以吗？
t.en: A recognition network wants S×S input, while photos come in every width and height. This level asks: the network wants 512×512 and the photo is 768×512 — can it simply be resized to 512×512?

t.zh: 测试图里画着一个正方形的东西：交出的 S×S 图里，它还得是正方形，多出来的部分从两边平均去掉，除不尽时左上少去掉一个像素。
t.en: The test images hold something square: in the S×S result it must still be square, and the excess is removed evenly from both sides, one pixel less at the top-left when it does not divide.

after.zh: 这样保住了<wiki-ref to="aspect-ratio"></wiki-ref>：宽和高乘同一个比例。
after.en: This keeps the <wiki-ref to="aspect-ratio"></wiki-ref>: width and height scaled by one factor.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和边长 S：按同一个比例缩放到短边等于 S，再从中间裁出 S×S。
brief.en: Given an image and a side S, scale it by one factor until its short side is S, then crop S×S from the middle.

hint.zh: 宽和高乘同一个数，宽高比才不变。
hint.en: Only multiplying width and height by one number keeps their ratio.

hint.zh: 缩放和裁剪都要整数的宽高。
hint.en: Resizing and cropping both need whole-number sizes.

solution: c = crop(r, x0, y0, S, S)

t.zh: 手机的数码变焦没有换镜头，它手上只有已经拍下的像素。这一关的问题是：它怎样把画面中间放大 k 倍？交出的图和输入一样大，显示的是原图中心那一部分放大 k 倍后的样子。
t.en: A phone's digital zoom changes no lens; all it has are the pixels already taken. This level asks: how does it magnify the middle of the picture k times? The result is as large as the input and shows the part at the original's centre magnified k times.

after.zh: 数码变焦只用已有的像素：它放大了画面，没有带来新的细节。
after.en: Digital zoom uses only the pixels already there: it magnifies the picture and brings no new detail.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和倍数 k：交出同样大小的图，内容是原图中心放大 k 倍。
brief.en: Given an image and a factor k, give an image of the same size showing the original's centre magnified k times.

hint.zh: 放大以后，原来的坐标也跟着放大了。
hint.en: After enlarging, the old coordinates are enlarged too.

solution: c = crop(image, x0, y0, cw, ch)
naive: c = crop(big, zero, zero, s.w, s.h)

body.zh: 相机把光变成电信号，计算机存下的是数：灰度图是 高 × 宽 的二维数组，每格是一个像素的亮度；彩色图多一维通道，是 高 × 宽 × 3 的张量，每个像素是 (R, G, B) 三个数。数组的形状先写高、再写宽。一个像素只说这里有多亮，不说这一点离相机多远。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 8、22）。
body.en: The camera turns light into a signal and the computer stores numbers: a greyscale image is a height × width array, each cell one pixel's brightness; a colour image adds a channel axis, a height × width × 3 tensor, each pixel three numbers (R, G, B). The shape lists height first, then width. A pixel says how bright a place is, not how far it is from the camera. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 8, 22).

body.zh: 图像坐标从左上角起、从 0 数：x 向右增大，y 向下增大，和数学课上 y 轴朝上的坐标不同。按数组读时先行后列，写成 I[y, x]；OpenCV 的尺寸却写成 (宽, 高)。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，像素坐标（幻灯片 26）。
body.en: Image coordinates start at the top-left corner and count from 0: x grows to the right and y grows downwards, unlike the upward y of school geometry. Read as an array, row comes first: I[y, x]; OpenCV, though, writes a size as (width, height). Source: COMP90086 lecture 2, pixel coordinates (slide 26).

body.zh: 针孔相机把三维点 (X, Y, Z) 投到离针孔 f 的像平面上：x = fX/Z，y = fY/Z（相似三角形）。同样大的物体越远像越小，焦距 f 越长像越大；像只定出 H/Z 的比，大而远和小而近成同一个像。讲义把像平面画在针孔前面，像不倒过来：这是坐标约定，不是传感器真正的位置。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 11、18）。
body.en: A pinhole camera projects a 3D point (X, Y, Z) onto the image plane at distance f from the hole: x = fX/Z, y = fY/Z (similar triangles). An object of a given size images smaller the farther it is and larger the longer f is; the image fixes only the ratio H/Z, so large-and-far and small-and-near image alike. The lectures draw the image plane in front of the hole, so the image is upright: a coordinate convention, not where the sensor really is. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 11, 18).

body.zh: 针孔小，进光少，图暗；把孔开大，同一点的光落到传感器上的不同地方，图就糊。透镜让大孔进来的光重新会聚到一点，但只对对焦距离上的点会聚得准，别的距离的点在传感器上成一个模糊圈。光圈直径管进光量，焦距管像的大小，两者不能混。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，相机为什么需要透镜（幻灯片 12–13）。
body.en: A small pinhole lets in little light and the image is dark; widen the hole and light from one point lands at different places on the sensor, and the image blurs. A lens brings the light through a wide opening back to a point, but only for points at the focus distance; points at other depths make a blur circle on the sensor. The aperture diameter sets the light, the focal length the image size; the two are not to be confused. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2, why cameras need lenses (slides 12–13).

body.zh: 同时显得清晰的深度范围。光圈小，模糊圈小，景深大，但进光少；光圈大，进光多，景深窄。摄影上用 f 数 = 焦距 / 光圈直径表示光圈：70 mm 镜头在 f/5.6 时光圈直径约 12.5 mm，f/32 的光圈更小、景深更大。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，光圈与景深（幻灯片 16）。
body.en: The range of depths that look sharp at once. A small aperture makes small blur circles and a deep range but lets in little light; a large aperture lets in more light and the range narrows. Photography states the aperture as the f-number = focal length / aperture diameter: a 70 mm lens at f/5.6 has an aperture of about 12.5 mm, and f/32 is a smaller aperture with a deeper range. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2, aperture and depth of field (slide 16).

body.zh: 传感器大小一定时，焦距决定看得多宽：焦距短，视场大；焦距长，视场小，物体在图里显得大。图像宽 2000 像素、主点居中、焦距 1000 像素时，每边约 45°，视场约 90°。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，焦距与视场（幻灯片 15）。
body.en: With the sensor size fixed, the focal length decides how wide the camera sees: a short focal length gives a wide field of view, a long one a narrow view in which objects look larger. For an image 2000 pixels wide with the principal point in the middle and a focal length of 1000 pixels, each side covers about 45° and the field of view is about 90°. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2, focal length and field of view (slide 15).

body.zh: 像平面上的长度以毫米计，图像里的长度以像素计，两者靠传感器的尺寸换算（每个像素多少毫米）。以像素计的焦距就是物理焦距除以像素尺寸。物体在 20 mm、200 像素高的传感器上占 100 像素，就是 10 mm：先换成毫米，再代入 h/f = H/Z。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲与 workshop 2。
body.en: Lengths on the image plane are in millimetres and lengths in the image in pixels; the sensor's size converts one to the other (millimetres per pixel). The focal length in pixels is the physical focal length divided by the pixel size. An object covering 100 pixels of a sensor 20 mm and 200 pixels tall is 10 mm tall on it: convert to millimetres first, then use h/f = H/Z. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 and workshop 2.

body.zh: 彩色图三个通道怎么排没有统一约定：OpenCV 读图得到 BGR，Matplotlib 按 RGB 显示。顺序弄错，红和蓝对调，形状和尺寸都不变；换顺序只是重排通道，不改图像的内容和大小。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，通道顺序（幻灯片 25）与 workshop 2。
body.en: There is no single convention for ordering a colour image's three channels: OpenCV reads images as BGR, Matplotlib displays them as RGB. Get the order wrong and red and blue swap while the shape and size stay; reordering only rearranges the channels and changes neither content nor size. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2, channel ordering (slide 25), and workshop 2.

body.zh: 像素值有范围和类型：uint8 是 0 到 255 的整数，白是 255；处理时常换成 [0, 1] 的浮点数，好做加减乘除、不溢出。计算结果可以超出范围，显示时才把超出的值截到两端，存着的数不变：看上去一样白的两个像素，存的数可以不同。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲，像素坐标、数据类型与文件格式（幻灯片 26）。
body.en: Pixel values have a range and a type: uint8 holds whole numbers from 0 to 255, white being 255; processing often converts to floats in [0, 1] so that arithmetic works without overflow. Results may leave the range; only the display clips them to its ends, and the stored numbers stay: two pixels that look equally white can hold different values. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2, coordinates, data types and file formats (slide 26).

body.zh: 缩放一张图，要给新图的每个像素算出值，先得知道它在原图里的位置：在新图上铺一张采样网格，把每个新像素反向映射回原图的坐标，而不是把旧像素正向搬过去（那样放大时会留下空洞）。本课按像素中心对齐（OpenCV 的双线性缩放、PyTorch 的 align_corners=False 也这样）：宽从 m 变成 n 时，新像素 x 对应原图的 (x + 0.5)·m/n − 0.5。库与库的约定不同，所以要写明。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 34）。
body.en: To resize an image every new pixel needs a value, and first a position in the original: lay a sampling grid over the new image and map each new pixel back to coordinates in the original, rather than pushing old pixels forwards (which leaves holes when enlarging). This course aligns pixel centres, as OpenCV's bilinear resize and PyTorch's align_corners=False do: when a width m becomes n, new pixel x sits at (x + 0.5)·m/n − 0.5 in the original. Libraries differ in this convention, so it must be stated. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 34).

body.zh: 每个新像素复制原图里离它最近的那个像素的值。快，边缘硬，但放大后成块，缩小时整列整行的像素被丢掉，比取样间隔细的细节整个消失。离两边一样远时按约定取坐标较大的一边。它和裁剪不同：裁剪只取出已有的像素，不改尺寸。OpenCV 里叫 INTER_NEAREST。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 35）。
body.en: Each new pixel copies the value of the original pixel nearest to it. It is fast and keeps edges hard, but enlarging makes squares and shrinking drops whole rows and columns, so detail finer than the sample spacing vanishes. When a position is equally far from two pixels, the convention takes the larger coordinate. Unlike cropping, which takes existing pixels without resizing. OpenCV calls it INTER_NEAREST. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 35).

body.zh: 新位置落在两个相邻像素之间、离左边那个的距离是 t（0 ≤ t < 1）时，值取两边按距离的加权平均：(1 − t)·I[x0] + t·I[x0 + 1]。权重之和为 1，离得越近权重越大，所以新值介于两边之间，不只是照抄某一个旧像素。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 36，一维的情形）。
body.en: When a new position lies between two neighbouring pixels at distance t from the left one (0 ≤ t < 1), its value is their distance-weighted average: (1 − t)·I[x0] + t·I[x0 + 1]. The weights sum to 1 and the nearer pixel weighs more, so the new value lies between the two instead of copying one old pixel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 36, the one-dimensional case).

body.zh: 在二维里，新位置落在四个旧像素之间；横向距离为 H、纵向距离为 V 时，四个权重是 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV，和为 1，等于先沿 x、再沿 y 各做一次线性插值。它比最近邻平滑，却会把很锐的边变软，还会在标签图上造出不存在的值。双三次和 Lanczos 看更大的邻域，没有一种插值对每个任务都最好。OpenCV 里叫 INTER_LINEAR。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 36–37）。
body.en: In two dimensions a new position falls among four old pixels; with horizontal distance H and vertical distance V the four weights are (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V and HV, summing to 1 — the same as linear interpolation along x and then along y. It is smoother than nearest neighbour but softens very sharp edges and invents values that do not exist in a label map. Bicubic and Lanczos look at larger neighbourhoods; no interpolation is best for every task. OpenCV calls it INTER_LINEAR. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 36–37).

body.zh: 传感器的信号最后存成有限个取值：uint8 每个值是 0 到 255 的整数，共 256 级。把实数存成 L 级，先把它截到可表示的范围，再取最近的一级（四舍五入，不是截掉小数）。不同的值会落到同一级，量化丢掉的信息找不回来。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（数据类型、uint8 的范围）。
body.en: The sensor's signal ends up stored as finitely many values: in uint8 each value is a whole number from 0 to 255, 256 levels. Storing a real number in L levels first clips it to the representable range, then takes the nearest level (rounding, not cutting off the fraction). Different values fall into one level, and what quantisation discards cannot be recovered. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (data types, the uint8 range).

body.zh: 取原数组的一个子区域，已有的像素值原样保留，不算新值；缩放改变数组的大小，要给新位置算出值。NumPy 里写成 image[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w]。中心裁剪的起点是 x0 = ⌊(W − w)/2⌋、y0 = ⌊(H − h)/2⌋。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 34）与 workshop 2。
body.en: Takes a sub-region of the original array and keeps its pixel values as they are, computing nothing new; resizing changes the array's size and must compute values for the new positions. In NumPy it is image[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w]. A centre crop starts at x0 = ⌊(W − w)/2⌋, y0 = ⌊(H − h)/2⌋. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 34) and workshop 2.

body.zh: 图的宽与高之比。把 768×512 直接压成 512×512 会改变宽高比，物体变胖或变瘦；要保持比例，宽和高乘同一个比例（约 768×512 → 768 · 2/3 × 512 · 2/3），要的形状再用裁剪取出。OpenCV 的尺寸写成 (宽, 高)，NumPy 的形状是 (高, 宽, 通道)，不能照搬。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 34）与 workshop 2。
body.en: An image's width over its height. Squashing 768×512 straight into 512×512 changes it, and objects grow fatter or thinner; to keep proportions, scale width and height by one factor and take the wanted shape with a crop. OpenCV writes a size as (width, height) while a NumPy shape is (height, width, channels); one cannot be passed as the other. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 34) and workshop 2.

question.zh: 一个视觉系统能被问什么，一张图又能回答什么？
question.en: What can a vision system be asked, and what can one image answer?

why: Second pass: naive answers on the choice and grid slots (0A1, 0A2, 0B1, 0B2, 0C1, 1A1, 1A2, 1C2), each the slot's misconception with why it is wrong; 1C1 on the channel setting; 1A2's first image made 4 rows so the y-up reading lands on another cell

why.zh: 类别标签只说图里有什么，不说在哪里：问「各在哪里」的题要每个物体各有一个位置，标签里一个位置也没有。
why.en: A class label says what is in the picture, not where: a question about where each object is needs a position for every object, and the label holds none.

why.zh: 这张图只给每个像素标了类别：同一类的像素都是同一个数，挨着的两只狗连成一片，数不出有几只。
why.en: This map labels each pixel with its class only: every pixel of one class holds the same number, so two touching dogs merge into one region and cannot be counted.

why.zh: 这张和参照图视角相同，像素最像，可物体的形状变了；转过视角的那几张像素几乎全不同，转动相机却渲得出来。
why.en: This picture shares the reference's view and most of its pixels, yet the object's shape has changed; the turned pictures differ in nearly every pixel, and turning the camera renders them.

why.zh: 这张的明暗和参照图一样，靠背却换了地方；光照变了的那几张，调灯就渲得出来。
why.en: This picture's shading matches the reference, but the chair back has moved; the relit pictures are what the lamp renders when moved.

why.zh: 这个样例的预测和标注一致：答对的样例，置信度再高，也推翻不了「任何背景下都认得出」。要找的是预测和标注不一致的那个。
why.en: This case's prediction matches its label: a right answer, however confident, cannot refute 'recognises it against any background'. Look for a case whose prediction differs from its label.

why.zh: 按箱子在图里的大小定出了一个距离：可小而近的箱子和大而远的箱子渲出同一张图，距离和高度在候选场景里各不相同。
why.en: That reads one distance off the box's size in the image, but a small near box and a large far one render the same picture: depth and height differ between the candidate scenes.

why.zh: 这是按 宽 × 高 抄的：画面的第一行像素抄成了格子的第一列。数组先写高、再写宽，格子的第 y 行就是画面的第 y 行。
why.en: This is copied as width × height: the picture's first row went into the grid's first column. An array lists height first, then width; row y of the grid is row y of the picture.

why.zh: 这张图 2 像素宽、3 像素高，抄出来却是 2 行 3 列：行和列对调了，每一行要是画面里的一行像素。
why.en: The image is 2 pixels wide and 3 high, but this copy has 2 rows of 3: rows and columns are swapped, and each row must be one row of the picture's pixels.

why.zh: 只把 (1, 1) 的蓝色调到 1，得到 (1, 1, 1)，那是白色：纯蓝还要红和绿都是 0。
why.en: Raising only the blue number of (1, 1) gives (1, 1, 1), which is white: pure blue also needs its red and green at 0.

why.zh: 这是像数学课那样让 y 从最下面一行往上数：图像坐标的 y 从最上面一行往下数，(0, 1) 是左上角往下一格。
why.en: That counts y upwards from the bottom row, as in school geometry: image y counts down from the top row, so (0, 1) is one cell below the top-left corner.

why.zh: y = 0 被当成了最下面一行：图像的第 0 行在最上面，(2, 0) 在右上角。
why.en: y = 0 was taken as the bottom row: an image's row 0 is at the top, so (2, 0) is the top-right cell.

why.zh: x 和 y 写反了：这张图只有 3 列，x = 3 已经在图外；x 数列，y 数行。
why.en: x and y are swapped: this image has only 3 columns, so x = 3 lies outside it; x counts columns, y rows.

why.zh: 这是存着的数，不是显示出来的：屏幕只显示得出 0 到 1，−0.2 画成 0，1.2 画成 1，而存着的数照旧不变。
why.en: These are the stored numbers, not the displayed ones: a screen shows only 0 to 1, so −0.2 is drawn as 0 and 1.2 as 1, while the stored numbers stay as they were.

why.zh: 除以 255 没错，顺序却照 RGB 读了：OpenCV 读进来的三个数是 B、G、R，第一个数是蓝。
why.en: Dividing by 255 is right, but the numbers were read as RGB: OpenCV stores B, G, R, so the first number is blue.

value.zh: 工作台第一次接电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去。新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>取出彩色图的一个通道，取哪一个是它的设置：R、G 或 B，也就是每格的第一、第二或第三个数；<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图合成一张彩色图。
value.en: The workbench wires its first circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right. The new part <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref> takes one channel out of a colour image, and which one is its setting: R, G or B, the first, second or third number of each cell. <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images one colour image.

brief.zh: 输入是按 BGR 存的照片：交出同一张照片按 RGB 存的样子。
brief.en: The input is a photo stored as BGR: give the same photo stored as RGB.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个通道分别取出来看：设成 R 取出的那一张，装的是天空的什么颜色？
hint.en: Take the three channels out one by one: the one set to R, which colour of the sky does it hold?

brief.zh: 输入是按 BGR 存的照片：交出同一张照片按 RGB 存的样子。
brief.en: The input is a photo stored as BGR: give the same photo stored as RGB.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个通道分别取出来看：天空的蓝在哪一个里？
hint.en: Take the three channels out one by one: which holds the sky's blue?

value.zh: 工作台第一次接电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去。新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>取出彩色图的第 c 个通道，<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图合成一张彩色图；通道编号 0、1、2 作为输入摆在板上。
value.en: The workbench wires its first circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right. The new part <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref> takes channel c out of a colour image, and <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images one colour image; the channel numbers 0, 1 and 2 are on the board as inputs.

why: Second pass on the steps flagged thin: 1B2 gets the bench re-check its chain's step 3 asks for; 1B7's first bench gets a second goal pulling against 'all in view'; 1D3's circuit shrinks and enlarges back so the loss shows in its tests; 1D8's circuit gives the range of originals a stored level stands for

value.zh: 台上只有像平面的距离 f 能动。先在台上让像高达到目标；再对另外两组数不上台、先算出 f，最后拿其中一组上台验证。
value.en: Only the plane distance f turns on the bench. First bring the image to the target height there; then, for two other sets of numbers, work out f without the bench, and finally check one of them on it.

brief.zh: 物高 2、距离 10：把 f 设成你算出的值，看像高是不是 0.5。
brief.en: Height 2, depth 10: set f to the value you worked out, and see whether the image is 0.5 tall.

why.zh: f = 像高 × 距离，漏掉了物高：物高是 2，f = 5 时像高是 1，是目标的两倍。
why.en: f = image height × depth leaves out the object's height: with H = 2, f = 5 gives an image 1 tall, twice the target.

value.zh: 调焦距，让三支箭的像都落在传感器上，中间那支乙的像又不少于 40 像素高。
value.en: Set the focal length so all three arrows image on the sensor, with the middle arrow B at least 40 pixels tall.

why.zh: 把焦距拉长想看清楚些：每支箭都变大，两端的落到了传感器外面。
why.en: Lengthening the focal length to see better: every arrow grows, and the outer ones fall off the sensor.

why.zh: 焦距缩到最短：三支都进了画面，乙的像却只剩 20 像素高。
why.en: The focal length as short as it goes: all three are in view, but B's image is only 20 pixels tall.

value.zh: 最近邻缩放放大时成块。这一关换一个方向：最近邻缩小图像时，没被选中的旧像素去了哪里？先把条纹图缩到一半宽、再放大回原来的宽，同时交出每个新像素的采样位置；再判断原图的哪些列留在了结果里。
value.en: Nearest-neighbour enlarging makes squares. This level goes the other way: when nearest neighbour shrinks an image, what becomes of the old pixels it does not pick?
