body.en: Besides its spatial dimensions, an RGB image also has a channel dimension, so a colour filter can have size K_h×K_w×3. It looks at R, G and B in the same neighbourhood at once and sums all the products to give a single output value. A common mistake is to treat height×width×channel as an ordinary 2D image and forget that the kernel must also cover the channel dimension. A common mistake: Thinking colour filtering produces three output values, or operates on only one channel. Source: COMP90086 lecture 3 notes, §2 (slide 31).

title.zh: 像素换算成传感器毫米再求焦距
title.en: Converting pixels to sensor millimetres to find focal length

body.zh: 传感器高 20 mm 对应 200 像素，物体在图像中高 100 像素，所以它在传感器上高 h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm。物体实际高 h_o = 120 mm、距离 z = 600 mm，由相似三角形 h_i/f = h_o/z 得 f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm。重点是先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，不能直接把像素和毫米放进同一个比例式。常见的误解：直接把 100 像素当作 h_i 代入，得到单位混乱的 f = 100×600/120 = 500。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · 用传感器尺寸求焦距。
body.en: A sensor height of 20 mm corresponds to 200 pixels, and the object is 100 pixels high in the image, so its height on the sensor is h_i = 20 mm × 100/200 = 10 mm. The object's real height is h_o = 120 mm and its distance is z = 600 mm, so by similar triangles h_i/f = h_o/z, giving f = h_i·z/h_o = 10×600/120 = 50 mm. The key point is to convert pixels into millimetres on the sensor first; you cannot put pixels and millimetres directly into the same proportion. A common mistake: Substituting the 100 pixels directly as h_i, giving f = 100×600/120 = 500 with muddled units. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 ·.

title.zh: OpenCV 尺寸 (width, height) 与 NumPy 形状 (height, width, channels)
title.en: OpenCV (width, height) vs NumPy (height, width, channels)

body.zh: OpenCV 的大小 tuple 是 (width, height)，NumPy 形状却通常写成 (height, width, channels)。所以不能把 NumPy 的形状原样当作 OpenCV 的缩放尺寸，否则宽和高会对调。常见的误解：把 image.shape[:2] 直接传给 OpenCV 的缩放函数。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝。
body.en: An OpenCV size tuple is (width, height), whereas a NumPy shape is usually written (height, width, channels). So you cannot use a NumPy shape as-is as an OpenCV resize size, or the width and height will be swapped. A common mistake: Passing image.shape[:2] straight to OpenCV's resize function. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 ·.

title.en: Centre crop and copying a NumPy slice

body.zh: 对 H×W 图像做宽 w_c、高 h_c 的中心裁剪，起点为 x0 = ⌊(W−w_c)/2⌋、y0 = ⌊(H−h_c)/2⌋，然后取 image[y0:y0 + hc, x0:x0 + wc]（行方向 y 在前）。NumPy 切片常返回视图；如果要修改副本而不影响原裁剪，应使用 .copy()。常见的误解：把切片写成 image[x0:..., y0:...]；或以为切片得到的是独立副本，修改它不会影响原数组。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝。
body.en: To take a centre crop of width w_c and height h_c from an H×W image, the starting point is x0 = ⌊(W−w_c)/2⌋, y0 = ⌊(H−h_c)/2⌋; then take image[y0:y0 + hc, x0:x0 + wc] (the row direction y comes first). NumPy slicing often returns a view; if you want to modify a copy without affecting the original crop, use .copy(). A common mistake: Writing the slice as image[x0:..., y0:...]; or thinking a slice is an independent copy, so modifying it will not affect the original array. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 ·.

title.zh: OpenCV 的 BGR 与 Matplotlib 的 RGB

body.zh: cv2.imread 默认读入 BGR，但 matplotlib.pyplot.imshow 按 RGB 显示，所以显示前要用 cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) 转换。这只改变通道顺序，不改变图像内容或空间尺寸。常见的误解：显示时红蓝颠倒，却以为图片本身坏了；或以为转换会改变图像尺寸。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV 和 Matplotlib 的颜色顺序。
body.en: cv2.imread reads images as BGR by default, but matplotlib.pyplot.imshow displays them as RGB, so convert with cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) before displaying. This changes only the channel order, not the image content or spatial size. A common mistake: Seeing red and blue swapped on display and thinking the image itself is broken; or thinking the conversion changes the image size. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 · OpenCV Matplotlib.

title.zh: 修改通道值与避免 uint8 溢出
title.en: Editing a channel without uint8 overflow

body.zh: Workshop 中对 BGR 图像把红色通道改成蓝色与绿色通道的平均值：R'(x,y) = (G(x,y)+B(x,y))/2。如果原数组是 uint8，要先用较宽或浮点类型做计算，再明确 cast，避免溢出或隐式截断。常见的误解：在 BGR 数组里把第 0 个通道当成红色；或直接用 uint8 相加后再除以 2。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲笔记，§4 Workshop 2 · 缩放、中心裁剪和深拷贝。
body.en: In the workshop, the red channel of a BGR image is replaced by the average of the blue and green channels: R'(x,y) = (G(x,y)+B(x,y))/2. If the original array is uint8, first do the calculation in a wider or floating-point type, then cast explicitly, to avoid overflow or implicit truncation. A common mistake: Treating channel 0 of a BGR array as red; or adding directly in uint8 and then dividing by 2. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 notes, §4 Workshop 2 ·.

t.zh: 一台理想的针孔相机：场景里一点发出的光，只有穿过小孔的那一条落到像平面上。三维的场景就这样被压成一张二维的图（<wiki-ref to="image-formation-3d-to-2d"></wiki-ref>）。
t.en: An ideal pinhole camera: of all the light a scene point sends out, only the ray through the hole reaches the image plane. That is how a 3D scene is pressed into a 2D picture (<wiki-ref to="image-formation-3d-to-2d"></wiki-ref>).

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：点在哪里，它的像就落在哪里？先在相机台上移动一点，让像落进圆圈；再把你找到的关系接成一块电路，以后要投影就直接用它。
t.en: This level asks: where a point is, where does its image land? First move a point on the camera bench until its image lands in the circle; then wire the relation you found into a circuit, to use whenever something must be projected.

desc.zh: 输入物点的横向位置 X、距离 Z 和像平面距离 f，输出像点位置 u
desc.en: Takes a point's sideways position X, its distance Z and the plane distance f; gives the image position u

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>：u = fX/Z。距离加倍，像就缩一半；真相机为了进光够多装上镜头，但成像关系不变。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pinhole-projection"></wiki-ref>: u = fX/Z. Twice as far, half the image; real cameras add a lens for light, but the relation holds.

brief.zh: f = 2，点离小孔 Z = 4：横向移动这一点，让它的像落在 u = 1。
brief.en: f = 2, the point Z = 4 from the hole: move it sideways so its image lands at u = 1.

hint.zh: 顺着画出的光线看：它从点出发，穿过小孔，停在像平面上。像平面离小孔多远，点又离小孔多远？
hint.en: Follow the drawn ray from the point through the hole to the plane. How far is the plane from the hole, and the point?

why.zh: 把点放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：光线穿过小孔后，横向位置按 f/Z = 2/4 缩小了一半。
why.en: With the point at X = 1 the image lands at u = 0.5 only: through the hole, the sideways position shrinks by f/Z = 2/4, to half.

t.zh: 这一步接一块电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去，测试和隐藏测试都对才算对。
t.en: This step wires a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right; it is right when every test and hidden test is.

t.zh: 新元件：<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>。
t.en: New parts: <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、f：交出像点位置 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z and f, give the image position u.

hint.zh: 台子上 Z 加倍时，像离中心近了多少？f 加倍呢？
hint.en: On the bench, how much nearer the centre did the image come when Z doubled? And when f doubled?

t.zh: 投影把场景变成图，方向是正的：给定场景，图就定了，这是图形学的方向。视觉反过来，手里只有图，要说出场景（<wiki-ref to="vision-task-outputs"></wiki-ref>有类别、位置、每个像素的标签等各种形式）。
t.en: Projection turns a scene into a picture, the forward way: given the scene, the picture is settled, as in graphics. Vision goes back, from the picture to the scene (its <wiki-ref to="vision-task-outputs"></wiki-ref> take many forms: a class, a location, a label per pixel).

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：从一张图倒推回去，场景能定下来吗？先用投影的关系找出成一样大的像的物体，再判断关于一张图里的场景，哪些话一定成立、哪些一定不成立、哪些定不下来。
t.en: This level asks: going back from a picture, is the scene settled? First use the projection relation to find objects that image equally tall; then judge which statements about a pictured scene must hold, must fail, or cannot be settled.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>：投影丢了深度，大而远和小而近拍出同一张图，从图推场景常有不止一个答案。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="forward-vs-inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>: projection drops depth; big-and-far pictures like small-and-near, so a picture often has more than one scene behind it.

brief.zh: f = 2：选出像高都是 1、距离各不相同的两组以上。
brief.en: f = 2: choose two or more pairs that all image 1 tall, at different distances.

hint.zh: 像高 h = fH/Z。物高和距离一起翻倍，h 怎样变？
hint.en: The image height is h = fH/Z. When height and distance both double, what happens to h?

prompt.zh: 哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: Which pairs all image 1 tall, at different distances?

prompt.zh: 换一批：哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: Another set: which pairs all image 1 tall, at different distances?

why.zh: 挑了一样高的物体：可像高还取决于距离，高 2 的箱子在距离 2 处成的像高 2。成一样高的像的，是 H/Z 相同的那些。
why.en: That picks objects of one height, but the image also depends on distance: the crate 2 tall at distance 2 images 2 tall. Equal images come from equal H/Z.

brief.zh: 判断关于场景的每句话：成立、不成立，还是无法确定。
brief.en: Judge each statement about the scene: supported, contradicted, or undetermined.

hint.zh: 给出的场景只是渲得出这张图的场景之一。把红色立方体放大一倍、再推远一倍，图会变吗？
hint.en: The scene given is only one that renders this picture. Double the red cube's size and its distance: does the picture change?

hint.zh: 一张图只定下每个物体的 H/Z。红色立方体的 H 知道了，它的 Z 呢？蓝色立方体的呢？
hint.en: An image fixes only each object's H/Z. With the red cube's H known, what about its Z? And the blue cube's?

prompt.zh: 红色立方体离相机 6 米。
prompt.en: The red cube is 6 m from the camera.

prompt.zh: 右边的立方体是蓝色的。
prompt.en: The cube on the right is blue.

prompt.zh: 场景里有两个立方体。
prompt.en: The scene has two cubes.

prompt.zh: 红色立方体边长 1 米。
prompt.en: The red cube is 1 m on a side.

given.zh: 渲得出这张图的场景之一：红色立方体边长 1 米、离相机 6 米；蓝色立方体边长 0.6 米、离相机 6.5 米。
given.en: One scene that renders this picture: the red cube 1 m on a side and 6 m from the camera; the blue cube 0.6 m on a side and 6.5 m away.

prompt.zh: 红色立方体离相机 6 米。
prompt.en: The red cube is 6 m from the camera.

prompt.zh: 蓝色立方体离相机 6.5 米。
prompt.en: The blue cube is 6.5 m from the camera.

prompt.zh: 蓝色立方体边长 0.6 米。
prompt.en: The blue cube is 0.6 m on a side.

prompt.zh: 红色立方体离相机 3 米。
prompt.en: The red cube is 3 m from the camera.

given.zh: 图和上一轮相同，上一轮给出的场景也渲得出它。这一轮多知道一件事：红色立方体的边长确实是 1 米。
given.en: The picture is the last round's, and the scene given there still renders it. This round you also know: the red cube really is 1 m on a side.

why.zh: 把给出的那个场景当成了真实的场景：可放大一倍又推远一倍的场景渲出同一张图，一张图只定下每个物体的 H/Z。知道红色立方体边长 1 米，按 H/Z 定下它离相机 6 米；蓝色立方体的边长不知道，它的距离和大小仍然定不了。
why.en: That takes the scene given as the real one, but a scene scaled up and pushed back as much renders the same picture: an image fixes only each object's H/Z. Knowing the red cube is 1 m fixes its distance at 6 m by H/Z; the blue cube's size is unknown, so its distance and size stay open.

t.zh: 真相机的像平面是一块传感器：宽 36 mm，分成 1800 个像素，一个像素宽 0.02 mm。图里的位置用像素数，焦距也可以换成像素：毫米焦距除以每个像素的宽度。
t.en: A real camera's image plane is a sensor: 36 mm wide, split into 1800 pixels, each 0.02 mm. Positions in a picture are counted in pixels, and the focal length can be too: the focal length in millimetres over a pixel's width.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：焦距怎样决定拍得下多宽的视野，像素坐标又怎样从投影得出？先调焦距，让水平视场正好 90°；再用投影接出一块输出像素坐标的电路。
t.en: This level asks: how does the focal length decide how wide a view fits, and how do pixel coordinates come from the projection? First set the focal length so the horizontal field of view is exactly 90°; then wire the projection into a circuit that gives pixel coordinates.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：焦距越长视野越窄；半个画面宽等于像素焦距时，视场是 90°。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: the longer the focal length, the narrower the view; when half the frame equals the focal length in pixels, the view is 90°.

brief.zh: 传感器宽 36 mm、1800 像素：调焦距 f，让水平视场正好 90°。
brief.en: A 36 mm, 1800-pixel-wide sensor: set the focal length f so the horizontal field of view is exactly 90°.

hint.zh: 90° 的视场，一半是 45°：从小孔到画面边缘的那条光线，横着走的和往前走的一样多。
hint.en: Half of 90° is 45°: the ray from the hole to the frame's edge goes as far sideways as forwards.

why.zh: 以为焦距等于传感器宽度时视场是 90°：其实那时半宽 18 mm 只有焦距的一半，视场约 53°。焦距要等于半宽 18 mm。
why.en: Taking a focal length equal to the sensor's width for 90°: then the half-width, 18 mm, is half the focal length and the view about 53°. The focal length must equal the half-width, 18 mm.

t.zh: 像素坐标从画面左边数起，光轴穿过的那一点（主点）在画面中间，坐标是 c_x。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>。
t.en: Pixel coordinates count from the frame's left edge; the point the optical axis passes through (the principal point) sits mid-frame at c_x. New part: <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、像素焦距 f_px 和主点 c_x：交出像点的像素横坐标 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z, the focal length in pixels f_px and the principal point c_x, give the image's pixel column u.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> 已经会算以光轴为原点的位置；像素坐标的原点在哪里？
hint.en: The <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> already gives the position measured from the axis; where is the origin of pixel coordinates?

title.en: A picture is a table of numbers

t.zh: 传感器的每个像素记下一个亮度，一张灰度图就是一张 h 行、w 列的数表；彩色图的每格是红、绿、蓝三个数。约定：x 向右数、y 向下数，都从 0 开始，第 y 行第 x 列写作 (x, y)。
t.en: Each sensor pixel records a brightness, so a grey picture is a table of h rows and w columns; in a colour one each cell holds three numbers, red, green and blue. The convention: x counts right and y down, both from 0, and row y, column x is written (x, y).

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个像素在数表的哪里，怎样读出它的值？先在格子上指出坐标、改一个彩色像素，再接一块读相邻两个像素之差的电路。
t.en: This level asks: where in the table is a pixel, and how is its value read? First give a cell's coordinates and change a colour pixel on the grid, then wire a circuit that reads the difference between two neighbouring pixels.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref>：形状是 h × w（彩色再 × 3），坐标按<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>读作 (x, y)。
after.en: This is how an <wiki-ref to="image-array-checks"></wiki-ref> is laid out: its shape is h × w (× 3 in colour), read at (x, y) by the <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 写出高亮那一格的坐标 (x, y)。
brief.en: Write the coordinates (x, y) of the highlighted cell.

hint.zh: x 是第几列，y 是第几行，都从 0 数起。
hint.en: x is the column and y the row, both counted from 0.

why.zh: 这是先写行、再写列（矩阵的习惯）：图像坐标先写 x（列），再写 y（行），高亮的格子在第 1 行第 2 列，是 (2, 1)。
why.en: That gives the row first, the matrix way: image coordinates give x, the column, first and y, the row, second; the highlighted cell is in row 1, column 2, so (2, 1).

brief.zh: 把 (1, 0) 的像素改成纯红，其他格子不动。
brief.en: Change the pixel at (1, 0) to pure red, leaving every other cell as it is.

hint.zh: 一个彩色像素是三个数，按红、绿、蓝的顺序。
hint.en: A colour pixel is three numbers, in the order red, green, blue.

why.zh: 改的是 (0, 1)：x 和 y 写反了。(1, 0) 是第 0 行第 1 列。
why.en: That changes (0, 1): x and y swapped. (1, 0) is row 0, column 1.

t.zh: 这一步接一块电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去，测试和隐藏测试都对才算对。
t.en: This step wires a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right; it is right when every test and hidden test is.

t.zh: 新元件：<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>按坐标读出一个像素，<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数，<part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref>相减。
t.en: New parts: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads the pixel at coordinates, <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number, <part-ref to="part:sub"></part-ref> subtracts.

brief.zh: 输入一张灰度图和坐标 x、y：交出右边邻居 (x+1, y) 减去 (x, y) 的值。
brief.en: Given a grey image and coordinates x and y, give the value at (x+1, y) less the value at (x, y).

hint.zh: 取像素的两个坐标口，哪个是列、哪个是行？
hint.en: Of the lookup's two coordinate inputs, which is the column and which the row?

t.zh: 要一张小一点的图，有两种做法：裁剪是从原图里取一块，每个值都是原图里本来就有的；缩放是把整张图变成别的尺寸，新位置上的值要算出来。
t.en: There are two ways to a smaller picture: cropping takes a part of the original, every value one the original already has; resizing changes the whole picture's size, and the values at the new positions must be worked out.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：裁剪出的图，每个像素来自原图的哪里？先在格子上手裁一块，再接出一块裁剪电路。
t.en: This level asks: where in the original does each pixel of a crop come from? First crop by hand on the grid, then wire a cropping circuit.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、左上角 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h，输出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块
desc.en: Takes an image, the top-left corner x0, y0, and a width w and height h; gives the w × h block from (x0, y0)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>：裁剪只是平移坐标去取原值；缩放要在原图里没有像素的位置上算出新值。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>: a crop only shifts coordinates to read existing values; a resize must work out values where the original has no pixel.

brief.en: Crop the 2 × 2 block (width 2, height 2) starting at (1, 1).

hint.zh: 新图的 (0, 0) 来自原图的哪一格？
hint.en: Which cell of the original does the new (0, 0) come from?

why.zh: 这是从 (0, 0) 起裁的：新图的 (0, 0) 要取原图的 (1, 1)，每个坐标都加上左上角的偏移。
why.en: That crops from (0, 0): the new (0, 0) must read the original (1, 1); every coordinate adds the corner's offset.

t.zh: 一整张新图的每个像素都要算出它在原图的坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>：给定宽和高，给出两张坐标图，x 图每格是自己的 x，y 图每格是自己的 y；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>接上坐标图，就一次取出整张图。
t.en: Every pixel of a whole new image needs its coordinates in the original. New part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>: given a width and a height it gives two coordinate images, each cell of x holding its own x and of y its own y; fed coordinate images, <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads a whole image at once.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
brief.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h block from (x0, y0).

hint.zh: 先给新图每格一对自己的坐标，再挪到原图里去。
hint.en: First give each new cell its own coordinates, then move them into the original.

t.zh: 缩放时，新图的每个像素对应原图里的一个位置，这个位置一般不是整数：原图在那里没有像素。这一关先不管位置怎么算出来，题目直接给出。
t.en: When resizing, each pixel of the new image corresponds to a position in the original, seldom a whole number: the original has no pixel there. This level does not ask how the positions are worked out; they are given.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：落在像素之间的位置，最简单的取值办法是什么？先手算一行，再接一块电路。离两边一样远时，约定取坐标较大的一边；落到图外，取最近的边。
t.en: This level asks: what is the simplest value for a position between pixels? First work out a row by hand, then wire a circuit. When a position is equally far from two pixels, take the larger coordinate; outside the image, the nearest edge.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：照抄最近的像素，快、边缘硬，放大后成块，新图里只有原图已有的值。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: copy the nearest pixel; fast and hard-edged, blocky when enlarged, with only values the original had.

brief.zh: 这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的像素的值。
brief.en: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the pixel nearest each position.

hint.zh: 0.5 离 0 和 1 一样近；2.2 最近的像素是哪个？
hint.en: 0.5 is as near 0 as 1; which pixel is nearest 2.2?

why.zh: 这是一律向下取整：1.6 离 2 比离 1 近，却取了 1 的值；0.5 离两边一样近，按约定取 1。最近的整数是加 0.5 再向下取整。
why.en: That rounds every position down: 1.6 is nearer 2 than 1 but read 1; 0.5 is equally near both and by the convention reads 1. The nearest whole number is add 0.5, then round down.

t.zh: 位置用两张坐标图给出：x 图每格是要取的横坐标，y 图是纵坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>把数向下取整；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取最近的边。
t.en: The positions come as two coordinate images: each cell of x is the column to read, of y the row. New part: <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds down; <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read the nearest edge outside the image.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置最近的像素的值。
brief.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the pixel nearest each position.

hint.zh: 手算时你是怎样从 1.6 得到 2 的？
hint.en: By hand, how did you get from 1.6 to 2?

t.zh: 最近邻只会照抄：落在两个像素之间的位置，不是取左边就是取右边，离得近一点远一点都一样。放大后的图因此成块。
t.en: Nearest neighbour only copies: a position between two pixels reads the left one or the right one, however near it is to either. That is why enlargements come out blocky.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：位置落在像素之间，值能不能按它离各个像素的远近来算？先在一行上手算，再在 2 × 2 的方格里手算，最后接成电路。位置照旧直接给出，落到图外取最近的边。
t.en: This level asks: can a position between pixels take a value by how near it is to each? Work it out on a row by hand, then inside a 2 × 2 square, then wire it. The positions are given as before; outside the image, the nearest edge.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：四个邻居按 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV 加权，比最近邻平滑，也让锐利的边稍软。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: four neighbours weighted (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V, HV; smoother than nearest neighbour, it softens sharp edges a little.

brief.zh: [0, 4] 在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25 处取值：按到左右两个像素的距离加权，写出每个值。
brief.en: Read [0, 4] at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25, weighting the pixels either side by distance: write each value.

hint.zh: x = 0.25 离 0 有 0.25，离 1 有 0.75：离得近的那边该占几成？
hint.en: x = 0.25 is 0.25 from 0 and 0.75 from 1: what share should the nearer side take?

why.zh: 这是照抄最近的像素：0.25 和 0.75 位置不同，拿到的却是两端的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
why.en: That copies the nearest pixel: 0.25 and 0.75 sit apart yet read the ends. Weighted by distance, 0.25 reads 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

brief.zh: 这张 2 × 2 的图在 x、y 都取 −1/6、0.5、7/6 的 9 个位置取值：写出 3 × 3 的结果。
brief.en: Read this 2 × 2 image at the nine positions where x and y are each −1/6, 0.5 or 7/6: write the 3 × 3 result.

hint.zh: 中间那一行在 y = 0.5，正好在两行中间：先把上下两行各自横着算好，再竖着取中间。
hint.en: The middle row is at y = 0.5, right between the rows: work out the top and bottom rows across first, then take between them.

why.zh: 这是只横着加权、竖直方向照抄最近的一行：中间一行在两行正中，却整个抄了下面一行。竖着也按距离加权，中心是四个邻居的平均 6。
why.en: That weights across only and copies the nearest row: the middle row, right between two, copies the lower. Weighted by distance downwards too, the centre is the average of the four, 6.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和两张坐标图 x、y：交出每个位置按四个邻居距离加权的值。
brief.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give each position's value weighted from its four neighbours by distance.

hint.zh: 先找出左上的邻居：坐标向下取整；位置离它多远，就是右边和下边邻居的权重。
hint.en: First find the top-left neighbour: round the coordinates down; how far the position is from it is the weight of the neighbours right and below.

t.zh: 到这里，每个新值都只看原图的一个位置。可模糊、找边这样的处理，要看一个像素周围的一片：<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>。最常用的一种，是把邻域里的像素各乘一个权重再相加，这组权重叫<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的卷积核。
t.en: So far each new value looks at one position of the original. Blurring or finding edges needs the patch around a pixel: <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>. The commonest kind multiplies each pixel of the neighbourhood by a weight and adds them up; the weights are the kernel of a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：让一组权重沿着一行滑过去，每个位置算一次加权和，结果是什么样？先分清哪些处理只看一个像素，再手算一行，最后接成电路：输入一张图和左、中、右三个权重。
t.en: This level asks: sliding three weights along a row and taking the weighted sum at each position, what comes out? First tell which operations look at one pixel only, then work out a row by hand, then wire it: an image and the left, centre and right weights.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>：一组权重滑过整张图，每个位置算一次加权和。只算三格都在图里的位置，输出比原图窄 2。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>: a set of weights slides over the image, one weighted sum per position. Taking only positions with all three cells inside, the output is 2 narrower.

brief.zh: 选出每个输出像素只看原图同一位置那一个像素的处理。
brief.en: Choose the operations whose every output pixel looks at the one pixel at the same position only.

hint.zh: 模糊之后，一个像素的值和它的邻居有没有关系？
hint.en: After a blur, does a pixel's value depend on its neighbours?

prompt.zh: 哪些处理只看一个像素？
prompt.en: Which operations look at one pixel only?

label.zh: 彩色变灰：三个通道取平均
label.en: Colour to grey: average the three channels

label.zh: 模糊：和左右邻居取平均

why.zh: 模糊要和左右邻居取平均：输出的一个像素用到了原图三个位置，它是局部运算。
why.en: A blur averages with the neighbours: one output pixel uses three positions of the original, a local operation.

brief.zh: 权重左 1、中 0、右 −1 滑过这一行：写出三格都在图里的每个位置的加权和。
brief.en: Slide the weights left 1, centre 0, right −1 along this row: write the weighted sum at each position whose three cells are all inside.

hint.zh: 第一个位置以 x = 1 为中心：1 × 左邻 + 0 × 自己 + (−1) × 右邻。
hint.en: The first position is centred on x = 1: 1 × left + 0 × here + (−1) × right.

why.zh: 这是右邻减左邻：权重左 1、右 −1，是左邻减右邻。权重跟着位置走，不要颠倒。
why.en: That is right less left: with the left weight 1 and the right −1 it is left less right. The weights go with their positions.

t.zh: 这一步接一块电路：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去，测试和隐藏测试都对才算对。
t.en: This step wires a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right; it is right when every test and hidden test is.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref>读出图的宽 w 和高 h。只算三格都在图里的位置：输出宽 w − 2，第 x 格以原图的 x + 1 为中心。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref> gives an image's width w and height h. Take only positions with all three cells inside: the output is w − 2 wide, its cell x centred on the original x + 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

hint.zh: 输出的每格要取原图的三个像素：它们的 x 各是多少？
hint.en: Each output cell reads three pixels of the original: what is each one's x?

t.zh: 只算三格都在图里的位置时，输出比原图窄 2：最左和最右的像素缺一个邻居，没法算。很多时候需要输出和原图一样大。
t.en: Taking only positions with all three cells inside, the output is 2 narrower than the original: the leftmost and rightmost pixels lack a neighbour. Often the output must be as large as the original.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图外面没有像素，邻居缺了怎么办？约定在图外补 0。先手算一行，再接一块输出和原图一样宽的行滤波器，以后滤波都用它。
t.en: This level asks: there are no pixels outside the image, so what of the missing neighbours? The convention here pads with 0 outside. Work out a row by hand, then wire a row filter whose output is as wide as the original, the one every later filter uses.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和左、中、右三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the left, centre and right weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>：在图外补 0，输出就和原图一样大；补的值不同，边上的结果也不同。
after.en: These are the <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>: pad with 0 outside and the output is as large as the image; pad differently and the edges differ.

brief.zh: 三个权重都是 1/3（求左中右的平均），图外补 0：写出和原图一样宽的结果。
brief.en: All three weights 1/3 (the average of left, here and right), 0 outside: write the result, as wide as the row.

hint.zh: 最左一格的左邻在图外，算作 0。
hint.en: The leftmost cell's left neighbour is outside and counts as 0.

why.zh: 这是图外取最近的边：题目约定图外补 0，两端只有两个 3 和一个 0，平均是 2。
why.en: That reads the nearest edge outside: here 0 is padded outside, so each end averages two 3s and a 0, giving 2.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取 0。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read 0 outside the image.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：输出和原图一样宽，每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give an output as wide as the image, a × left + b × here + c × right at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 这回输出的第 x 格就以原图的 x 为中心。
hint.en: Now the output's cell x is centred on the original x.

t.zh: 行滤波器让左权重乘左邻、右权重乘右邻，权重和位置一一对应。课上的卷积却规定：先把卷积核左右翻转，再滑过去求加权和。
t.en: The row filter multiplies the left weight by the left neighbour and the right by the right: weights match positions. Convolution as the lecture defines it first flips the kernel left to right, then slides it and sums.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：翻不翻转，结果差在哪？用一行只有一个亮点的图（脉冲）来看：先手算不翻转的结果，再用行滤波器接出真正的卷积。
t.en: This level asks: what does flipping change? Look at a row with a single bright cell (an impulse): work out the unflipped result by hand, then wire true convolution from the row filter.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>：不翻转的是互相关，脉冲出来的是倒过来的核；卷积先翻转，脉冲出来的就是核本身。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="convolution-vs-cross-correlation"></wiki-ref>: without the flip it is correlation, and an impulse comes out as the kernel reversed; convolution flips first, and an impulse comes out as the kernel itself.

brief.zh: 不翻转，权重左 1、中 2、右 3 滑过这一行脉冲，图外补 0：写出结果。
brief.en: Without flipping, slide the weights left 1, centre 2, right 3 over this impulse, 0 outside: write the result.

hint.zh: 亮点左边那一格，算加权和时亮点是它的哪个邻居？
hint.en: For the cell left of the bright one, which neighbour is the bright cell?

why.zh: 以为脉冲出来的就是核 [1, 2, 3]：亮点在左边那一格的右邻，乘的是右权重 3。不翻转时，出来的是倒过来的 [3, 2, 1]。
why.en: Expecting the kernel [1, 2, 3] back: for the cell to its left, the bright cell is the right neighbour and meets the right weight 3. Without the flip, out comes [3, 2, 1] reversed.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和卷积核 k1、k2、k3（按书写顺序）：交出卷积的结果，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the kernel k1, k2, k3 (in written order), give the convolution, 0 outside.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> 不翻转；翻转之后，k1 落到哪一边？
hint.en: The <part-ref to="rowFilter"></part-ref> does not flip; flipped, which side does k1 land on?

t.zh: 行滤波器只沿着一行滑。图是二维的，上下的邻居同样有用。
t.en: The row filter slides along rows only. A picture is two-dimensional, and the neighbours above and below matter as much.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：同一个滑动加权和，换成竖直方向该怎么接？接一块列滤波器：输入一张图和上、中、下三个权重，输出和原图一样大，图外补 0。
t.en: This level asks: how is the same sliding weighted sum wired down the columns? Wire a column filter: an image and the above, centre and below weights, an output as large as the image, 0 outside.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和上、中、下三个权重 a、b、c，输出和原图一样大：每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image and the above, centre and below weights a, b, c; gives an output as large as the image, a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside

after.zh: 同一个<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>，只是邻居换成了上下：方向不同，计算一样。
after.en: The same <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>, the neighbours now above and below: another direction, the same computation.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 上邻 + b × 自己 + c × 下邻，图外补 0。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × above + b × here + c × below at each position, 0 outside.

hint.zh: 和行滤波器比，变的是哪个坐标？
hint.en: Compared with the row filter, which coordinate changes?

t.zh: 二维的卷积核是一张 3 × 3 的权重表。很多常用的核正好是一列权重乘一行权重：先横着滤一遍、再竖着滤一遍，和直接用 3 × 3 的核一样。这依赖<wiki-ref to="linear-filter-properties"></wiki-ref>：先后次序可以交换、两次滤波可以合成一次。
t.en: A 2D kernel is a 3 × 3 table of weights. Many common kernels are exactly a column of weights times a row: filtering across and then down equals filtering once with the 3 × 3 kernel. That rests on the <wiki-ref to="linear-filter-properties"></wiki-ref>: the order can be swapped, two filters can be merged into one.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个 3 × 3 的核，什么时候能拆成横、竖两步？先由一行和一列权重写出合成的 3 × 3 核，再用行滤波器和列滤波器接出二维滤波器。
t.en: This level asks: when can a 3 × 3 kernel be split into an across pass and a down pass? First write the 3 × 3 kernel a row and a column of weights make, then wire a 2D filter from the row and column filters.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、一行权重 h1、h2、h3 和一列权重 v1、v2、v3：先横着用行权重滤，再竖着用列权重滤，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image, a row of weights h1, h2, h3 and a column v1, v2, v3: filters across with the row, then down with the column, 0 outside

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>：3 × 3 的核若是一列乘一行，就拆成两次 3 格的滤波，每个像素少算 3 次乘法。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>: a 3 × 3 kernel that is a column times a row splits into two 3-cell passes, three fewer multiplications a pixel.

brief.zh: 行权重 [1, 2, 1]、列权重 [1, 2, 1]：写出合成的 3 × 3 核，第 y 行第 x 列是列权重第 y 个乘行权重第 x 个。
brief.en: Row weights [1, 2, 1], column weights [1, 2, 1]: write the merged 3 × 3 kernel, row y, column x being column weight y times row weight x.

hint.zh: 中心那一格是 2 × 2。
hint.en: The centre cell is 2 × 2.

why.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重：竖直方向也要乘上列权重，第 1 行整行乘 2。
why.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows: the column weights multiply too, doubling row 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、行权重 h1、h2、h3 和列权重 v1、v2、v3：交出先横后竖两次滤波的结果。
brief.en: Given an image, row weights h1, h2, h3 and column weights v1, v2, v3, give the result of filtering across, then down.

hint.zh: 第二次滤波的输入，是第一次的输出。
hint.en: The second pass takes the first pass's output.

t.zh: 把一个像素和它的邻居平均，图就模糊了。均值滤波每个邻居一样重；高斯滤波让中心最重、越远越轻，模糊得更柔和、没有方块感。
t.en: Averaging a pixel with its neighbours blurs the picture. A mean filter weighs every neighbour equally; a Gaussian weighs the centre most and the farther ones less, a softer blur without blockiness.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个亮点经过高斯模糊，会变成什么样？先手算，再用二维滤波器接一个高斯模糊器：行和列的权重都是 1/4、1/2、1/4。
t.en: This level asks: what does a single bright point become after a Gaussian blur? Work it out by hand, then wire a Gaussian blur from the 2D filter, the row and column weights both 1/4, 1/2, 1/4.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 横竖各滤一遍的模糊图，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image; gives it blurred by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] across and down, 0 outside

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>：一个亮点变成中间亮、四周渐暗的一团。核越大、σ 越大，模糊越强。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="gaussian-filter"></wiki-ref>: a bright point becomes a blob, bright in the middle and fading out. The larger the kernel and σ, the stronger the blur.

brief.zh: 这张图只有 (1, 1) 是 16：横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤一遍，图外补 0，写出结果。
brief.en: Only (1, 1) of this image is 16: filter across and down with [1/4, 1/2, 1/4], 0 outside, and write the result.

hint.zh: 先横着滤：16 分到左、中、右三格各是多少？
hint.en: Filter across first: how much of the 16 goes to the left, centre and right?

why.zh: 这是只横着滤了一遍：竖直方向也要滤，亮点向上下扩散，中心只剩 4。
why.en: That filters across only: down must be filtered too, spreading the point up and down and leaving 4 at the centre.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出横竖各用 [1/4, 1/2, 1/4] 滤过的模糊图。
brief.en: Given an image, give it filtered across and down by [1/4, 1/2, 1/4].

hint.zh: <part-ref to="filter2D"></part-ref> 要六个权重。
hint.en: The <part-ref to="filter2D"></part-ref> takes six weights.

solution: f = filter2D(image, q, h, q, q, h, q)
naive: f = filter2D(image, t, t, t, z, o, z)

t.zh: 边是亮度突然变化的地方。右邻减左邻，在平坦处是 0，在边上不是 0：这就是一个找边的核。再竖着用 [1, 2, 1] 平均一下，抗噪声更好，就是 Sobel 核。
t.en: An edge is where brightness changes suddenly. Right less left is 0 on flat ground and not 0 on an edge: an edge-finding kernel. Averaging down the column with [1, 2, 1] resists noise better: that is the Sobel kernel.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：Sobel 的两个响应 gx、gy 在不同方向的边上各是什么？先判断正负，再接一块同时输出 gx 和 gy 的 Sobel 滤波器。
t.en: This level asks: what are Sobel's two responses gx and gy on edges running different ways? First judge their signs, then wire a Sobel filter giving gx and gy together.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，输出横向响应 gx（右邻减左邻，竖直用 [1, 2, 1] 平均）和纵向响应 gy（下邻减上邻，横向用 [1, 2, 1] 平均）
desc.en: Takes an image; gives the across response gx (right less left, averaged [1, 2, 1] down) and the down response gy (below less above, averaged [1, 2, 1] across)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>：gx 对竖着的边有响应，gy 对横着的边有响应；从暗到亮为正，从亮到暗为负。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>: gx responds to upright edges and gy to level ones; dark to bright is positive, bright to dark negative.

brief.zh: gx = 右邻减左邻，gy = 下邻减上邻：判断每种边上的响应。
brief.en: gx = right less left, gy = below less above: judge the response on each edge.

hint.zh: 左暗右亮：右邻比左邻亮还是暗？
hint.en: Dark left, bright right: is the right neighbour brighter or darker than the left?

prompt.zh: 左暗右亮的竖直边上，gx 是？
prompt.en: On an upright edge, dark left and bright right, gx is?

prompt.zh: 左亮右暗的竖直边上，gx 是？
prompt.en: On an upright edge, bright left and dark right, gx is?

prompt.zh: 上暗下亮的横向边上，gx 是？
prompt.en: On a level edge, dark above and bright below, gx is?

prompt.zh: 上暗下亮的横向边上，gy 是？
prompt.en: On a level edge, dark above and bright below, gy is?

why.zh: 以为有边就有正的响应：响应带符号，从亮到暗是负；和边平行的方向上没有变化，响应是 0。
why.en: Taking every edge as a positive response: the response is signed, bright to dark negative; along the edge nothing changes, and the response is 0.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出 gx（横向权重 −1、0、1，竖向 1、2、1）和 gy（横向 1、2、1，竖向 −1、0、1）。
brief.en: Given an image, give gx (across −1, 0, 1; down 1, 2, 1) and gy (across 1, 2, 1; down −1, 0, 1).

hint.zh: 两个响应都是二维滤波器，只是权重不同。
hint.en: Both responses are 2D filters with different weights.

solution: x = filter2D(image, m, z, o, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, m, z, o)
naive: x = filter2D(image, o, z, m, o, w, o)
y = filter2D(image, o, w, o, m, z, o)

title.en: The gradient: how strong, which way

t.zh: <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref>：gx 和 gy 合起来是一个箭头，叫梯度，指向亮度增加最快的方向；它的长度说明边有多强，不管边朝哪边。
t.en: An <wiki-ref to="edge-as-rapid-change"></wiki-ref>: gx and gy together make an arrow, the gradient, pointing the way brightness rises fastest; its length says how strong the edge is, whichever way it runs.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样不管方向、只量出边有多强？先判断几种情况下梯度指向哪边，再用 Sobel 接出梯度的大小。新元件开平方。
t.en: This level asks: how is an edge's strength measured, whatever its direction? First judge which way the gradient points in a few cases, then wire the gradient's size from the Sobel filter. New part: square root.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>：方向由 gx、gy 定，大小是 √(gx² + gy²)。这台边缘检测器后面还会用到。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>: its direction set by gx and gy, its size √(gx² + gy²). This edge detector is used again later.

brief.zh: 梯度指向亮度增加最快的方向（y 向下）：选出每种情况下的方向。
brief.en: The gradient points where brightness rises fastest (y down): choose its direction in each case.

hint.zh: gx 是横向的分量，gy 是纵向的分量。
hint.en: gx is the across component, gy the down one.

prompt.zh: gx = 4，gy = 0
prompt.en: gx = 4, gy = 0

prompt.zh: gx = 0，gy = −4
prompt.en: gx = 0, gy = −4

prompt.zh: gx = −3，gy = 0
prompt.en: gx = −3, gy = 0

why.zh: gy 为负，说明往下变暗、往上变亮：y 向下数，梯度指向上方。
why.en: A negative gy means darker downwards and brighter upwards: y counts down, so the gradient points up.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref>给出平方根。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref> gives the square root.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：交出每个位置的梯度大小 √(gx² + gy²)。
brief.en: Given an image, give the gradient's size √(gx² + gy²) at each position.

hint.zh: gx、gy 有正有负；直接相加，正负会抵消。
hint.en: gx and gy can be negative; added as they are, they cancel.

t.zh: 彩色图每个像素有三个数。处理彩色图的核也有三层，每个通道一层：三层各自滤过自己的通道，再加起来，得到一张图。
t.en: A colour picture has three numbers a pixel. A kernel for it has three layers too, one per channel: each filters its own channel, and the three are added into one picture.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：三个通道各自模糊、再按权重加起来，结果是什么？新元件取通道，取出每个像素第 0、1、2 个位置（红、绿、蓝）上的数，组成一张灰度图。
t.en: This level asks: blur each channel, then add them up by weights; what comes out? New part: channel takes the number at position 0, 1 or 2 (red, green, blue) of every pixel as a grey image.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>：核有几层就对应几个通道，各层结果相加成一张图。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>: a kernel has a layer per channel, and the layers' results add up to one picture.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>：在元件上设定取第几个位置。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>; set on the part which position it takes.

brief.zh: 输入一张彩色图和权重 wr、wg、wb：把三个通道各自高斯模糊，再按 wr × 红 + wg × 绿 + wb × 蓝 加起来。
brief.en: Given a colour image and the weights wr, wg, wb, Gaussian-blur each channel, then add wr × red + wg × green + wb × blue.

hint.zh: 先把三个通道分开，各自模糊，再乘权重。
hint.en: First take the three channels apart, blur each, then weight them.

t.zh: Workshop 2 的一道题：知道物体多高、多远，从照片里量出它占多少像素，反推镜头的焦距。照片里量的是像素，相似三角形要的是传感器上的毫米。
t.en: A Workshop 2 exercise: knowing how tall and how far an object is, measure how many pixels it covers in the photo and work back to the lens's focal length. The photo gives pixels; similar triangles want millimetres on the sensor.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：像素和毫米怎样换算，才能代进相似三角形？传感器高 smm 毫米、spx 像素；物体在图里高 hpx 像素，实际高 H、距离 Z（毫米）。
t.en: This level asks: how are pixels and millimetres converted before the similar triangles? The sensor is smm millimetres and spx pixels high; the object covers hpx pixels and is H tall and Z away, in millimetres.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，再用 h/f = H/Z；像素和毫米不能放进同一个比例式。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert pixels to millimetres on the sensor first, then h/f = H/Z; pixels and millimetres never share a proportion.

brief.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出焦距 f（毫米）。
brief.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the focal length f in millimetres.

hint.zh: 一个像素在传感器上有多少毫米？
hint.en: How many millimetres of sensor is one pixel?

title.en: Width, height and a centre crop

t.zh: NumPy 给出图的形状时先写行数（高）、再写列数（宽）；OpenCV 要尺寸时却先写宽、再写高。Workshop 2 要从图的正中间裁出一块，两种顺序一混，裁出的位置就偏了。
t.en: NumPy gives an image's shape as rows (height) first, then columns (width); OpenCV asks for a size as width first, then height. Workshop 2 crops a block from the very centre, and mixing the two orders puts it off-centre.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：已知形状 (rows, cols)，正中间那一块的左上角在哪？
t.en: This level asks: given the shape (rows, cols), where is the centre block's top-left corner?

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>的差别：形状先高后宽，尺寸先宽后高；<wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref>的左上角是 ((宽 − w)/2, (高 − h)/2) 向下取整。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref> difference: a shape is height first, a size width first; a <wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref> starts at ((width − w)/2, (height − h)/2), rounded down.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
brief.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the block at the very centre.

hint.zh: 横向的余量是哪个数减 w？
hint.en: The room left across is which number less w?

solution: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)
naive: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)

t.zh: Workshop 2 里用 OpenCV 读进来的照片，三个数按 B、G、R 存；交给 Matplotlib 按 R、G、B 显示，红蓝就对调了，蓝天变成橙色。另一个坑：照片常用 uint8 存，0 到 255，算出来超出范围会绕回去。
t.en: In Workshop 2 a photo read with OpenCV stores its three numbers as B, G, R; shown by Matplotlib as R, G, B, red and blue trade places and a blue sky turns orange. Another trap: photos are often uint8, 0 to 255, and a result out of range wraps around.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样把颜色换回来，加亮时又怎样避免绕回？新元件<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图依次当作 R、G、B 合成彩色图。
t.en: This level asks: how are the colours put back, and how is wrapping avoided when brightening? New part: <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> makes three grey images R, G and B of one colour image.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref>的差别和<wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref>的坑：交给另一个库前换好顺序，算之前先换成更宽的类型。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="opencv-bgr-to-rgb"></wiki-ref> difference and the <wiki-ref to="channel-edit-dtype"></wiki-ref> trap: swap the order before handing over, widen the type before computing.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?

brief.zh: uint8 只能存 0 到 255：选出 uint8 里算出的结果。
brief.en: uint8 holds 0 to 255 only: choose what uint8 arithmetic gives.

hint.zh: 超过 255 的部分会从 0 重新数起：256 存成 0。
hint.en: Past 255 it counts on from 0: 256 is stored as 0.

why.zh: uint8 存不下 300：超出的部分绕回去，300 − 256 = 44。要先换成更宽的类型再加。
why.en: uint8 cannot hold 300: it wraps, 300 − 256 = 44. Widen the type before adding.

step.why: The first two chapters of the course map: the camera and the convolver

t.zh: 针孔只放进一条光线，图很暗；把孔开大，同一点的光落到传感器上一大片，图就糊。相机在孔的位置装一块焦距 50 mm 的透镜：它把从一点射来的一大束光重新收拢成一点。收拢在哪里，取决于这一点有多远；转动对焦，就是挪动传感器去接住某个距离上收拢的点。
t.en: A pinhole lets in one ray and the image is dark; widen the hole and one point's light spreads over the sensor, and the image blurs. A camera puts a 50 mm lens where the hole was: it gathers a wide beam from a point back into a point. Where that happens depends on how far the point is; turning the focus moves the sensor to catch the points of one distance.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：透镜能让近处和远处同时清晰吗？台上有 1 m 处的花和 4 m 处的门，光圈固定。只调对焦距离，让远处的门清晰：它在传感器上的斑不超过清晰门槛 0.03 mm。先想好再按「检查」，检查之后才画出光线和每个深度的斑。
t.en: This level asks: can a lens make near and far sharp at once? The bench holds a flower at 1 m and a door at 4 m; the aperture is fixed. Turn only the focus distance so the far door is sharp: its spot on the sensor no wider than the 0.03 mm threshold. Decide before you press Check; only then are the rays and each depth's spot drawn.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="focus"></wiki-ref>：透镜只把对焦距离上的点收成点，别的距离上的点落成一块斑。对焦在两者中间，两个都不清晰。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="focus"></wiki-ref>: a lens brings only the points at the focus distance to points; points at other distances land as spots. Focused halfway, neither is sharp.

brief.zh: 光圈不动，只调对焦距离：让 4 m 处的门清晰。
brief.en: With the aperture fixed, turn only the focus distance: make the door at 4 m sharp.

hint.zh: 透镜把哪个距离上的点收成点？
hint.en: Which distance does the lens bring to points?

why.zh: 对焦在两者中间，想两个都照顾到：门的斑有 0.04 mm，花的更大，两个都不清晰。透镜只把一个距离收成点。
why.en: Focusing halfway to favour both: the door's spot is 0.04 mm and the flower's larger, so neither is sharp. A lens brings one distance to points.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 光圈直径 A 管进来多少光：进光量和 A² 成正比，这里以 2 mm 光圈的进光为 1。离焦的点落成的斑有一个还算清晰的上限，台上的清晰门槛 0.03 mm 就是<wiki-ref to="acceptable-blur"></wiki-ref>：斑小到分不出是不是一个点，就算清晰。
t.en: The aperture diameter A sets how much light comes in: light goes as A², counted here against a 2 mm aperture as 1. The spot an out-of-focus point makes has a limit below which it still counts as sharp; the bench's 0.03 mm threshold is the <wiki-ref to="acceptable-blur"></wiki-ref>: a spot too small to tell from a point is sharp.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：光圈开大，除了更亮，还换来了什么？对焦锁在 2 m 处的人身上，身后 2.5 m 是一面墙。只调光圈：进光量至少 4，墙也要清晰。先想好再按「检查」。
t.en: This level asks: a wider aperture is brighter; what else does it bring? The focus is locked on a person at 2 m, with a wall behind them at 2.5 m. Turn only the aperture: the light at least 4, and the wall sharp too. Decide before you press Check.

after.zh: 离焦的点落成的斑叫<wiki-ref to="blur-circle"></wiki-ref>：它的直径和光圈成正比。光圈开大，光多了，斑也大了；亮和清晰要互相让。
after.en: The spot an out-of-focus point makes is its <wiki-ref to="blur-circle"></wiki-ref>: its diameter is proportional to the aperture. Open up and there is more light, and bigger spots; brightness and sharpness trade against each other.

brief.zh: 对焦锁在 2 m：只调光圈，进光量至少 4，2.5 m 处的墙清晰。
brief.en: Focus locked at 2 m: turn only the aperture, with the light at least 4 and the wall at 2.5 m sharp.

hint.zh: 检查过一档光圈后，看墙的斑：光圈加倍，斑变成多大？
hint.en: Once one aperture is checked, look at the wall's spot: double the aperture, how big does it get?

hint.zh: 进光量和 A² 成正比：要到 4，A 至少多大？
hint.en: Light goes as A²: what A gives at least 4?

why.zh: 光圈开到最大，只当它更亮：进光量 25，墙的斑却有 0.05 mm，超过了门槛。斑的直径随光圈一起长。
why.en: Opening fully, as if it only brightened: the light is 25, but the wall's spot is 0.05 mm, over the threshold. The spot grows with the aperture.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 对焦距离上的点收成点，前后的点落成斑，斑随着离开对焦距离越来越大。斑还在清晰门槛以下的那一段距离，前后都算清晰。
t.en: Points at the focus distance come to points; points before and behind land as spots that grow the farther they are from it. The stretch of distances where the spot stays under the threshold counts as sharp.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：近处和远处都要清晰，又要够亮，光圈和对焦各放在哪里？1 m 处的人和 3 m 处的门都要清晰，进光量（以 1.5 mm 光圈为 1）不低于 1。光圈和对焦都能调；先想好再按「检查」，检查后才画出斑随深度变化的曲线。
t.en: This level asks: with near and far both to be sharp and light enough, where do the aperture and the focus go? A person at 1 m and a door at 3 m must both be sharp, and the light (a 1.5 mm aperture counting as 1) at least 1. Both the aperture and the focus turn; decide before you press Check, and only then is the curve of spot size against depth drawn.

after.zh: 斑不超过容许模糊圈的那段距离叫<wiki-ref to="depth-of-field"></wiki-ref>：光圈越小它越长、光越少。它在对焦两边都有，对焦放在两者之间才用得上。
after.en: The range where the spot stays within the acceptable blur is the <wiki-ref to="depth-of-field"></wiki-ref>: a smaller aperture lengthens it and lets in less light. It spans both sides of the focus, so focus between the two.

brief.zh: 同时调光圈和对焦距离：1 m 和 3 m 都清晰，进光量不低于 1。
brief.en: Set the aperture and the focus together: 1 m and 3 m both sharp, the light at least 1.

hint.zh: 对焦在一个物体上时，清晰的那一段有一边落在两个物体外面，用不上。
hint.en: Focused on one of the objects, one side of the sharp stretch lies beyond both of them, unused.

hint.zh: 光圈不能小于 1.5 mm：在这个光圈下，对焦挪到哪里，清晰的一段刚好盖住两个物体？
hint.en: The aperture cannot go under 1.5 mm: at that aperture, where must the focus go for the sharp stretch to cover both?

why.zh: 对准近处的人、光圈开到够亮：清晰的一段从 1 m 往两边伸，到不了 3 m，门糊了。
why.en: Focusing on the near person with the aperture open enough: the sharp stretch spreads both ways from 1 m and does not reach 3 m; the door blurs.

why.zh: 对焦放对了，光圈却开得更大：斑长得快，清晰的一段缩短，两头都出了界。
why.en: The focus is right, but the aperture wider: the spots grow faster, the sharp stretch shortens and both ends fall outside it.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 相机台上是一台理想的针孔相机：场景里一点发出的光，只有穿过小孔的那一条落到像平面上。像平面离小孔 f，点离小孔 Z、偏离光轴 X；台上把像平面画在小孔前面，像是正的。
t.en: The bench holds an ideal pinhole camera: of all the light a scene point sends out, only the ray through the hole reaches the image plane. The plane is f from the hole, the point Z away and X off the axis; the bench draws the plane in front of the hole, so the image is upright.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一点放在哪里，它的像才落在像平面上画圈的位置？两个任务各开一个旋钮：先横向移动这一点，再前后移动它。先想好放在哪里再按「检查」，检查之后才画出光线和像；像落进圆圈才算对。
t.en: This level asks: where must a point be for its image to land on the circled spot of the image plane? Each of the two tasks opens one knob: first move the point sideways, then in depth. Decide where to put it before you press Check; the ray and the image are drawn only once you check. It is right when the image lands in the circle.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="central-projection"></wiki-ref>：像点在物点和小孔的连线上，u = fX/Z。物点离得越远，同样的横向偏移在像上越小。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="central-projection"></wiki-ref>: the image lies on the line through the point and the hole, u = fX/Z. The farther the point, the smaller the same sideways offset becomes in the image.

brief.zh: f = 2，点离小孔 Z = 4：横向移动这一点，让它的像落在 u = 1。
brief.en: f = 2, the point Z = 4 from the hole: move it sideways so its image lands at u = 1.

hint.zh: 顺着画出的光线看：它从点出发，穿过小孔，停在像平面上。像平面离小孔多远，点又离小孔多远？
hint.en: Follow the drawn ray from the point through the hole to the plane. How far is the plane from the hole, and the point?

why.zh: 把点放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：光线穿过小孔后，横向位置按 f/Z = 2/4 缩小了一半。
why.en: With the point at X = 1 the image lands at u = 0.5 only: through the hole, the sideways position shrinks by f/Z = 2/4, to half.

brief.zh: f = 2，点偏离光轴 X = 2：只前后移动它，让像落在 u = 0.5。
brief.en: f = 2, the point X = 2 off the axis: move it only in depth so its image lands at u = 0.5.

hint.zh: Z = 2 时像在 u = 2。退到两倍远，像挪到哪里？要挪到四分之一呢？
hint.en: At Z = 2 the image is at u = 2. Twice as far, where does it go? To get a quarter of that?

why.zh: 退到两倍远，像只挪到 u = 1：像的位置和距离成反比，要到 u = 0.5，得退到四倍远。
why.en: Twice as far, the image moves only to u = 1: its position is inversely proportional to the distance, so u = 0.5 needs four times as far.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 一支竖着的箭从光轴立起，高 H。箭的两端各有一条光线穿过小孔，两条线在像平面上截出的那一段，就是箭的像，高 h。
t.en: An upright arrow stands H tall on the axis. A ray from each end passes the hole, and the stretch the two rays cut out of the image plane is the arrow's image, h tall.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：物体离得越远，像矮多少？换一支镜头，像又高多少？第一个任务只能前后移动箭，第二个任务箭不动，只能调像平面到小孔的距离 f。像高等于圆圈标出的高度才算对；先想好，再按「检查」。
t.en: This level asks: how much shorter does an image get as the object moves away, and how much taller with another lens? The first task moves only the arrow in depth; in the second the arrow stays and only f, the plane's distance from the hole, turns. It is right when the image is as tall as the circled mark; decide first, then press Check.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="perspective-scaling"></wiki-ref>：像高 h = fH/Z，和距离成反比、和 f 成正比。距离加倍，像缩成一半。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="perspective-scaling"></wiki-ref>: the image height h = fH/Z, inversely proportional to distance and proportional to f. Twice as far, half as tall.

brief.zh: 箭高 H = 2，f = 2：只前后移动箭，让像高 h = 1。
brief.en: The arrow H = 2 tall, f = 2: move it only in depth so its image is h = 1 tall.

hint.zh: Z = 2 时像和箭一样高。像要变成一半，距离要怎样变？
hint.en: At Z = 2 the image is as tall as the arrow. For half that, how must the distance change?

why.zh: 以为距离多 1，像就矮 1：Z = 3 时像高是 1.33。像高按 1/Z 变，要矮一半，距离得加倍。
why.en: Taking one step back for one unit off the image: at Z = 3 it is 1.33 tall. Height goes as 1/Z; half as tall needs twice as far.

brief.zh: 箭高 H = 2，离小孔 Z = 8：箭不动，只调 f，让像高 h = 0.75。
brief.en: The arrow H = 2 tall, Z = 8 away: leave it there and turn only f, so its image is h = 0.75 tall.

hint.zh: f = 1 时像高 0.25。要三倍高，f 要怎样变？
hint.en: At f = 1 the image is 0.25 tall. Three times as tall needs what f?

why.zh: 以为差多少补多少：f 加 0.5，像高只到 0.375。像高和 f 成正比，要三倍高，f 也要三倍。
why.en: Adding what is missing: f up by 0.5 brings the image only to 0.375. Height is proportional to f; three times as tall needs three times f.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 到这里，任务都是由物体求像。反过来：看到一个像有多高，能说出物体多高、多远吗？
t.en: So far every task has gone from the object to its image. The other way round: from how tall an image is, can you tell how tall and how far the object is?

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：哪些物体会成一样高的像？f = 2，每一轮给出几组（物高, 距离），选出至少两组：每组的像高都是 1，距离各不相同。
t.en: This level asks: which objects image equally tall? With f = 2, each round lists several (height, distance) pairs; choose at least two that all image 1 tall, no two at the same distance.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="scale-ambiguity"></wiki-ref>：物高和距离同比放大，像一点不变。一张像只定下 H/Z，大而远和小而近分不出来。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="scale-ambiguity"></wiki-ref>: scale an object's height and distance together and its image does not change. An image fixes only H/Z; big and far cannot be told from small and near.

brief.zh: f = 2：选出像高都是 1、距离各不相同的两组以上。
brief.en: f = 2: choose two or more pairs that all image 1 tall, at different distances.

hint.zh: 像高 h = fH/Z。物高和距离一起翻倍，h 怎样变？
hint.en: The image height is h = fH/Z. When height and distance both double, what happens to h?

prompt.zh: 哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: Which pairs all image 1 tall, at different distances?

prompt.zh: 换一批：哪几组的像高都是 1、距离又各不相同？
prompt.en: Another set: which pairs all image 1 tall, at different distances?

why.zh: 挑了一样高的物体：可像高还取决于距离，高 2 的箱子在距离 2 处成的像高 2。成一样高的像的，是 H/Z 相同的那些。
why.en: That picks objects of one height, but the image also depends on distance: the crate 2 tall at distance 2 images 2 tall. Equal images come from equal H/Z.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 画一张图是由场景到图像：物体、光照、相机都给定，图就定了，这是<wiki-ref to="graphics-vision"></wiki-ref>里图形学的方向。视觉走反方向，手里只有图，要说出场景是什么样。
t.en: Drawing goes from scene to image: given the objects, the light and the camera, the image is settled; that is the graphics side of <wiki-ref to="graphics-vision"></wiki-ref>. Vision goes the other way: it holds only the image and must say what the scene is like.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：只看一张图，场景里哪些事能确定，哪些确定不了？每一轮给一张图，图旁写着这一轮已知的事。判断关于场景的每句话：凡是渲得出这张图、又符合已知的场景里它都成立，选「成立」；都不成立，选「不成立」；有的成立、有的不成立，选「无法确定」。
t.en: This level asks: from one image alone, what about the scene can be settled and what cannot? Each round gives an image, with what the round lets you know beside it. Judge each statement about the scene: true in every scene that renders this image and fits what is known, Supported; false in all of them, Contradicted; true in some and false in others, Undetermined.

after.zh: 从图推回场景是<wiki-ref to="inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>：大而远和小而近渲出同一张图。图只能确定所有相容场景都同意的事，距离要靠别的线索。
after.en: Going from an image back to a scene is an <wiki-ref to="inverse-problem"></wiki-ref>: big-and-far renders like small-and-near. An image settles only what every compatible scene agrees on; distance needs another cue.

brief.zh: 判断关于场景的每句话：成立、不成立，还是无法确定。
brief.en: Judge each statement about the scene: supported, contradicted, or undetermined.

hint.zh: 给出的场景只是渲得出这张图的场景之一。把红色立方体放大一倍、再推远一倍，图会变吗？
hint.en: The scene given is only one that renders this picture. Double the red cube's size and its distance: does the picture change?

hint.zh: 一张图只定下每个物体的 H/Z。红色立方体的 H 知道了，它的 Z 呢？蓝色立方体的呢？
hint.en: An image fixes only each object's H/Z. With the red cube's H known, what about its Z? And the blue cube's?

prompt.zh: 红色立方体离相机 6 米。
prompt.en: The red cube is 6 m from the camera.

prompt.zh: 右边的立方体是蓝色的。
prompt.en: The cube on the right is blue.

prompt.zh: 场景里有两个立方体。
prompt.en: The scene has two cubes.

prompt.zh: 红色立方体边长 1 米。
prompt.en: The red cube is 1 m on a side.

given.zh: 渲得出这张图的场景之一：红色立方体边长 1 米、离相机 6 米；蓝色立方体边长 0.6 米、离相机 6.5 米。
given.en: One scene that renders this picture: the red cube 1 m on a side and 6 m from the camera; the blue cube 0.6 m on a side and 6.5 m away.

prompt.zh: 红色立方体离相机 6 米。
prompt.en: The red cube is 6 m from the camera.

prompt.zh: 蓝色立方体离相机 6.5 米。
prompt.en: The blue cube is 6.5 m from the camera.

prompt.zh: 蓝色立方体边长 0.6 米。
prompt.en: The blue cube is 0.6 m on a side.

prompt.zh: 红色立方体离相机 3 米。
prompt.en: The red cube is 3 m from the camera.

given.zh: 图和上一轮相同，上一轮给出的场景也渲得出它。这一轮多知道一件事：红色立方体的边长确实是 1 米。
given.en: The picture is the last round's, and the scene given there still renders it. This round you also know: the red cube really is 1 m on a side.

why.zh: 把给出的那个场景当成了真实的场景：可放大一倍又推远一倍的场景渲出同一张图，一张图只定下每个物体的 H/Z。知道红色立方体边长 1 米，按 H/Z 定下它离相机 6 米；蓝色立方体的边长不知道，它的距离和大小仍然定不了。
why.en: That takes the scene given as the real one, but a scene scaled up and pushed back as much renders the same picture: an image fixes only each object's H/Z. Knowing the red cube is 1 m fixes its distance at 6 m by H/Z; the blue cube's size is unknown, so its distance and size stay open.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 把一张图放大或缩小，新图的每个像素都要有一个值；算值之前，先得知道它落在原图的哪里。约定是：原图第 x 个像素是一个宽 1 的格子，中心在 x，占 x − 0.5 到 x + 0.5；新图的像素平分原图这一整段长度。
t.en: Enlarging or shrinking an image gives every pixel of the new image a value; before any value, each must know where it sits in the original. The convention: pixel x of the original is a cell 1 wide, centred on x, spanning x − 0.5 to x + 0.5; the new pixels share the original's whole length equally.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：缩放时，新图的每个像素落在原图的哪里？第一个任务在格子上手算一行，可以填分数（如 −1/6）；第二个任务接一块电路，交出整张新图的两张源坐标图，测试的坐标都对才算对。
t.en: This level asks: when an image is resized, where in the original does each new pixel sit? The first task works out one row by hand on the grid, fractions welcome (−1/6); the second wires a circuit that gives the whole new image's two source-coordinate images, right when every tested coordinate is.

desc.zh: 输入原图的宽 sw、高 sh 和新图的宽 nw、高 nh，输出新图每个像素在原图里的 x、y（两张坐标图）
desc.en: Takes the original's width sw and height sh and the new width nw and height nh; gives each new pixel's x and y in the original (two coordinate images)

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>：每个新像素反向映射回原图，落点一般不在旧像素的中心上，常在两个旧像素之间。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="sampling-grid"></wiki-ref>: each new pixel mapped back into the original, landing seldom on an old pixel's centre and often between two.

brief.zh: 原图这一行 2 个像素，占 −0.5 到 1.5，长 2。放大成 3 个像素，三个新像素平分这段长度：写出每个新像素中心的 x。可以填分数，如 1/3。
brief.en: This row of 2 pixels spans −0.5 to 1.5, a length of 2. Enlarged to 3 pixels, the three new ones share that length equally: write the x of each new pixel's centre. Fractions are fine, such as 1/3.

hint.zh: 每个新像素宽多少？第一个从 −0.5 开始，它的中心在哪里？
hint.en: How wide is each new pixel? The first starts at −0.5: where is its centre?

hint.zh: 中间那个新像素的中心，正好在整段的正中。
hint.en: The middle new pixel's centre is right in the middle of the whole length.

after.zh: 新像素不是旧像素换了编号：中间那个落在两个旧像素之间。
after.en: New pixels are not old ones renumbered: the middle one falls between two old pixels.

label.zh: 新像素中心在原图里的 x
label.en: x of each new pixel's centre in the original

why.zh: 这是把新像素当成旧像素重新编号：原图这一行只有 x = 0 和 x = 1 两个像素，x = 2 落在原图外面。新旧两排一样长，三个新像素中心要分布在两个旧像素占的那段长度上。
why.en: That renumbers the new pixels as if they were old ones: the original row has pixels at x = 0 and x = 1 only, so x = 2 lies outside it. The two rows are equally long, so the three new centres spread over the length the two old pixels cover.

t.zh: 手算一行可以，一整张图要每个像素各算一遍，就要电路了：输入从左边进来，输出从右边出去。新图的每个像素先要有自己的坐标，而手上没有元件能从两个数造出一整张图。
t.en: One row works by hand; a whole image, every pixel worked out, needs a circuit: inputs come in on the left, outputs leave on the right. Each new pixel first needs its own coordinates, and nothing in hand makes a whole image out of two numbers.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>给定宽和高，给出每格就是自己 x、y 的两张坐标图。坐标还要换算：<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数，<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref>、<part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref>对数和整张图逐个值地算。
t.en: The new part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref> takes a width and a height and gives the two coordinate images whose cells hold their own x and y. The coordinates still need converting: <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number, and <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>, <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:div"></part-ref> work value by value on numbers and whole images.

brief.zh: 输入原图和新图的宽高：交出新图每个像素在原图里的 x 坐标图和 y 坐标图。
brief.en: Given the original's and the new width and height, give the image of each new pixel's x in the original, and the image of its y.

hint.zh: 先给新图的每个像素一对它自己的坐标。
hint.en: First give every pixel of the new image its own pair of coordinates.

hint.zh: 新图的一个像素宽，相当于原图的几个像素宽？像素中心和像素左边差多少？
hint.en: One pixel of the new image is how many pixels of the original wide? How far is a pixel's centre from its left edge?

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 有了<part-ref to="sampleGrid"></part-ref>，每个新像素都知道自己落在原图的哪里；可这个位置一般不是整数，原图在那里没有像素。
t.en: With the <part-ref to="sampleGrid"></part-ref> every new pixel knows where it sits in the original; but that position is seldom a whole number, and the original has no pixel there.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：落在两个旧像素之间的新像素，最简单的取值办法是什么？新元件<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>按整数坐标在图上取值，<part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref>读出图的宽高，<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>把一个数向下取整。离两边一样远时，约定取坐标较大的一边。输出图逐格和期望相符才算对。
t.en: This level asks: what is the simplest value for a new pixel between two old ones? New parts: <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads an image at whole-number coordinates, <part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref> gives an image's width and height, and <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds a number down. When a position is equally far from two pixels, the convention takes the larger coordinate. It is right when the output matches the expected image cell by cell.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour"></wiki-ref>：每个新像素照抄离它最近的旧像素。快、边缘硬，放大后成块，新图里只有原图已有的值。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour"></wiki-ref>: each new pixel copies the nearest old one. Fast and hard-edged, blocky when enlarged, with no value the original did not already have.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，每个新像素照抄原图里离它最近的那个像素。
brief.en: Given an image and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel copying the original pixel nearest to it.

hint.zh: 取像素只接受整数坐标，也不接受原图外面的坐标。
hint.en: The lookup takes only whole-number coordinates, and none outside the image.

hint.zh: 离一个坐标最近的整数，和它向下取整得到的整数，什么时候不一样？
hint.en: When does the whole number nearest a coordinate differ from the one rounding down gives?

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 最近邻只会照抄：[0, 4] 放大成 4 像素，新像素不是 0 就是 4。可中间的新像素离两边的距离不一样，照抄丢掉了这个信息。
t.en: Nearest neighbour only copies: [0, 4] enlarged to 4 pixels gives every new pixel 0 or 4. Yet the middle ones sit at different distances from the two sides, and copying throws that away.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：新像素一定要等于某一个旧像素吗？先在格子上手算一行，再接一块电路：输入一行像素和新的宽、高，交出缩放后的图。这一关的图都只有一行；测试和隐藏测试的每个值都对才算对。
t.en: This level asks: must a new pixel equal one of the old ones? First work one row out by hand on the grid, then wire a circuit: given a row of pixels and a new width and height, give the resized image. This level's images are all one row high; it is right when every value in the tests and hidden tests is.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：新像素按到左右两个旧像素的距离加权，离谁近谁的份量大，两份权重加起来是 1。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: a new pixel weighs its left and right neighbours by distance, the nearer counting more, the two weights adding to 1.

brief.zh: [0, 4] 放大成 4 像素：新像素落在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25。按到两边旧像素的距离，写出每个新像素的值；落在两端外面的，取最近的边。
brief.en: [0, 4] enlarged to 4 pixels: the new pixels sit at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25. Write each one's value by its distance to the old pixels on either side; one beyond an end takes the nearest edge.

hint.zh: x = 0.25 离 x = 0 有 0.25，离 x = 1 有 0.75。离得近的那一边该占几成？
hint.en: x = 0.25 is 0.25 from x = 0 and 0.75 from x = 1. What share should the nearer side take?

why.zh: 这是照抄最近的旧像素：x = 0.25 和 x = 0.75 落在不同的位置，却拿到一样的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
why.en: That copies the nearest old pixel: x = 0.25 and x = 0.75 sit at different places but get one value each side. Weighted by distance, 0.25 gives 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

brief.zh: 输入一行像素和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，每个新像素由左右两个旧像素按距离加权。
brief.en: Given a row of pixels and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel weighted from its left and right old pixels by distance.

hint.zh: 中间那个新像素离左右两个旧像素各有多远？
hint.en: How far is the middle new pixel from each of the two old ones?

hint.zh: 先找出新位置左边那个旧像素，再算新位置离它有多远。
hint.en: First find the old pixel to the left of the new position, then how far the position is from it.

hint.zh: 两端的新位置落在原图之外：取像素可以设成取最近的边。
hint.en: The new positions at the ends fall outside the original: the lookup can be set to read the nearest edge.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 一行像素之间，新像素按左右两个邻居加权。放大一张二维的图，新像素在上下方向也落在两行之间：它周围有四个旧像素。
t.en: Within a row, a new pixel weighs its left and right neighbours. Enlarging a 2D image, a new pixel also falls between two rows: there are four old pixels around it.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：落在四个旧像素围成的方格里的新像素，值怎么算？先在格子上手算一张 2 × 2 的图放大成 3 × 3，再接一块电路：输入一张图和新的宽、高，交出缩放后的图，二维放大和缩小的测试都对才算对。
t.en: This level asks: how is a new pixel inside the square of four old ones worked out? First work a 2 × 2 image enlarged to 3 × 3 by hand on the grid, then wire a circuit: given an image and a new width and height, give the resized image, right when the tests of enlarging and shrinking in two dimensions all are.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：上下两行各沿 x 插值，再沿 y 插一次，得到四个邻居的加权平均，比最近邻平滑。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="bilinear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: along x on the rows above and below, then along y, a weighted average of the four neighbours, smoother than nearest neighbour.

brief.zh: 这张 2 × 2 的图放大成 3 × 3：新像素的 x、y 都落在 −1/6、0.5、7/6。写出 3 × 3 的值；落在外面的取最近的边。
brief.en: This 2 × 2 image is enlarged to 3 × 3: the new pixels' x and y both fall at −1/6, 0.5 and 7/6. Write the 3 × 3 values; positions outside take the nearest edge.

hint.zh: 中间那一行落在 y = 0.5，正好在两行中间：它该等于哪一行？
hint.en: The middle row falls at y = 0.5, right between the two rows: which row should it equal?

hint.zh: 先把上下两行各自横着放大，再在两行之间竖着取。
hint.en: Enlarge the top and bottom rows across first, then take between the two rows downwards.

why.zh: 只横着插了一次，竖直方向照抄最近的一行：中间一行落在两行正中，却整个抄了下面那一行。竖着也按距离加权，中心是四个邻居的平均 6。
why.en: That interpolates across only and copies the nearest row downwards: the middle row, right between the two, copies the lower one whole. Weighted by distance downwards too, the centre is the four neighbours' average, 6.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，每个新像素由周围四个旧像素按距离加权。
brief.en: Given an image and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel weighted from the four old pixels around it by distance.

hint.zh: 竖直方向也有一个距离：新位置离上面那一行有多远。
hint.en: There is a vertical distance too: how far the new position is from the row above.

hint.zh: 上下两行各沿 x 插一次，得到两个值，再在它们之间沿 y 插一次。
hint.en: Interpolate along x on the row above and on the row below, then along y between the two results.

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

t.zh: 彩色图的每个像素存三个数，各是哪种颜色，看存的顺序。OpenCV 读进来的照片按 B、G、R 存；拿去按 R、G、B 显示，红和蓝就对调了：一张蓝天的照片显示出橙色的天空。
t.en: A colour image stores three numbers a pixel, and which colour each is depends on the order they are stored in. A photo read with OpenCV is stored as B, G, R; shown as R, G, B, red and blue trade places, and a blue sky shows orange.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：怎样把这张照片的颜色换回来？新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>取出每个像素第 0、1 或 2 个位置上的数（在元件上设定），组成一张灰度图；<part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref>把三张灰度图依次当作 R、G、B，合成一张彩色图。每个像素都和期望相符才算对。
t.en: This level asks: how do you put the photo's colours back? New parts: <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref> takes the number at position 0, 1 or 2 of every pixel, as set on the part, as a grey image; <part-ref to="part:compose"></part-ref> takes three grey images as R, G and B, in that order, and makes one colour image. It is right when every pixel matches the expected one.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>的差别：OpenCV 按 BGR 存，Matplotlib 按 RGB 显示，交给另一个库前要换过来。
after.en: This is a difference of <wiki-ref to="channel-order"></wiki-ref>: OpenCV stores BGR and Matplotlib shows RGB, so swap the order before handing an image over.

brief.zh: 输入是用 OpenCV 读进来的照片：交出同一张照片，颜色和本来的一样。
brief.en: The input is a photo read with OpenCV: give the same photo in its true colours.

hint.zh: 先把输入原样接到输出，看第一个不同的格子里哪几个数对调了。
hint.en: First wire the input straight to the output, and see which numbers are swapped in the first differing cell.

hint.zh: 把三个位置的数分别取出来看：天空在哪一张里最亮？蓝天本该亮在哪一种颜色上？
hint.en: Take the numbers at the three positions out one by one: in which of them is the sky brightest? Which colour should a blue sky be bright in?

title.en: The camera: from scene to pixels

question.zh: 场景怎样变成一张数表，数表又怎样在任意位置取值？
question.en: How does a scene become a table of numbers, and how is the table read at any position?

question.zh: 怎样把一个像素和它的邻居合起来算，造出模糊器和边缘检测器？
question.en: How is a pixel combined with its neighbours, to build a blur and an edge detector?

value.zh: 三条梯子，各从一个浅显的起点爬到第 1、2 讲的一个核心：一张图为什么定不了深度，透镜怎样在亮和清晰之间取舍，缩放时新像素怎样从四个邻居算出。
value.en: Three ladders, each climbing from a plain starting point to a core of lectures 1–2: why one image cannot settle depth, how a lens trades light against sharpness, and how resizing works a new pixel out of four neighbours.

question.zh: 一张图从哪里来、能说明什么，图里的像素又怎样重新采样？
question.en: Where does an image come from, what can it tell, and how are its pixels resampled?

title.en: An image does not settle depth

body.zh: 彩色像素的三个数按什么顺序存是约定：OpenCV 读进来的是 B、G、R，Matplotlib 显示时当成 R、G、B，不换就红蓝颠倒。出处：COMP90086 第 2 次 workshop。常见的误解：三个数总是 R、G、B。
body.en: The order a colour pixel's three numbers are stored in is a convention: OpenCV reads B, G, R, Matplotlib shows R, G, B; without a swap red and blue trade places. Source: COMP90086 workshop 2. A common mistake: The three numbers are always R, G, B.

body.zh: 新像素落在四个旧像素之间时，先横着做两次线性插值，再竖着做一次：四个邻居的加权平均，权重 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV 加起来是 1。比最近邻平滑，会让锐利的边稍微变软。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 36）。常见的误解：只横着插一次就够了。
body.en: A new pixel among four old ones is two linear interpolations across, then one down: a weighted average of the four, the weights (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V, HV adding to 1. Smoother than nearest neighbour; it softens sharp edges a little. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 36). A common mistake: Interpolating across once is enough.

body.zh: 新像素按它到两个邻居的距离加权：离谁近，谁的份量大；正中间就是两者的平均。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 36）。常见的误解：新像素只能照抄某一个旧像素。
body.en: A new pixel weighs its two neighbours by distance: the nearer counts more; halfway is their average. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 36). A common mistake: A new pixel can only copy an old one.

body.zh: 每个新像素照抄离它最近的旧像素：快、边缘硬，放大后成块。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 35）。常见的误解：坐标一律向下取整就是最近的那个。
body.en: Each new pixel copies the nearest old pixel: fast and hard-edged, blocky when enlarged. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 35). A common mistake: Rounding every coordinate down picks the nearest pixel.

body.zh: 缩放时，新图每个像素的中心按比例落回原图：新旧两排像素占同样长的一段，新像素中心常落在两个旧像素之间。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 34）。常见的误解：新像素的下标就是原图的下标。
body.en: When resizing, each new pixel's centre maps back into the original in proportion: both rows span the same length, so new centres often fall between old pixels. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 34). A common mistake: A new pixel's index is its place in the original.

body.zh: 对焦距离前后，模糊圈还小于容许模糊圈的那一段距离。光圈越小，斑长得越慢，这一段越长，可进光也越少。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 16）。常见的误解：对焦在其中一个物体上、光圈开大，两个都会清晰。
body.en: The range of distances around the focus where the blur circle stays within the acceptable blur. A smaller aperture grows the spot more slowly and lengthens the range, at the cost of light. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 16). A common mistake: Focus on one of them and open the aperture, and both will be sharp.

body.zh: 斑小到眼睛（或一个像素）分不出来，就算清楚。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 16）。
body.en: A spot too small for the eye (or a pixel) to tell from a point counts as sharp. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 16).

body.zh: 离焦的点在传感器上落成一块圆斑；光圈越大，进光越多，这块斑也越大。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 16）。常见的误解：光圈越大越好：只是更亮。
body.en: An out-of-focus point lands on the sensor as a round spot; the wider the aperture, the more light and the bigger the spot. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 16). A common mistake: The wider the better: it is only brighter.

body.zh: 透镜把一大片光收拢，可只能把一个距离上的点收成点；别的距离上的点落成一块斑。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 12–13）。常见的误解：对焦在两个物体中间，两个都清楚。
body.en: A lens gathers much more light, but brings the points of only one distance to points; points at other distances land as spots. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 12–13). A common mistake: Focusing halfway makes both sharp.

body.zh: 从图像推回场景时，常有不止一个场景给出同一张图：投影把深度丢掉了。一张图能确定的只是所有相容场景都同意的事；其余要靠另外的线索（已知的物体大小、第二台相机……）。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲（幻灯片 8）。常见的误解：从像的大小就能读出物体的距离和大小。
body.en: Going from an image back to a scene, more than one scene often gives the same image: projection drops depth. An image settles only what every compatible scene agrees on; the rest needs other cues (a known size, a second camera…). Source: COMP90086 lecture 1 (slide 8). A common mistake: An image's size tells how far and how big the object is.

body.zh: 图形学由场景生成图像；视觉反过来，从图像推回场景。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲（幻灯片 8）。
body.en: Graphics makes an image from a scene; vision goes the other way, from an image back to a scene. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1 (slide 8).

body.zh: 物高和距离同比放大，像一点不变：一张像只定下物高和距离的比值 H/Z。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 9–11）。常见的误解：物高一样，像就一样高。
body.en: Scale an object's size and distance by the same factor and its image does not change: an image fixes only the ratio H/Z. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 9–11). A common mistake: Equal heights give equal images.

body.zh: 物体的像高 h = fH/Z：和距离成反比，距离加倍，像缩成一半。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 9–11）。常见的误解：距离每多一点，像就少同样多一点（按差来减）。
body.en: An object's image height is h = fH/Z: inversely proportional to the distance; twice as far, half as tall. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 9–11). A common mistake: Each step farther takes the same amount off the image (a difference, not a ratio).

body.zh: 针孔相机里，物点发出的光只有穿过小孔的那一条落到像平面上：像点在物点和小孔连成的直线上，横向位置 u = fX/Z。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 11）。常见的误解：像就落在和物点同样的横向位置上（u = X）。
body.en: In a pinhole camera only the ray through the hole reaches the image plane: the image of a point lies on the line through the point and the hole, at u = fX/Z. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 11). A common mistake: The image lands at the point's own lateral position (u = X).

learner.zh: 学过编程和中学数学、没有学过计算机视觉的学习者（COMP90086 的学生）
learner.en: Learners who can program and know school mathematics but have not studied computer vision (COMP90086 students)

endpoint.zh: 看懂一张图从哪里来、能说明什么：针孔投影为什么让一张图定不了深度，透镜为什么在亮和清晰之间取舍，缩放时新像素的值怎样从四个邻居算出。
endpoint.en: Understand where an image comes from and what it can tell: why pinhole projection leaves depth unsettled, why a lens trades light against sharpness, and how resizing works a new pixel out of four neighbours.

scope.zh: 示范课程，覆盖第 1、2 讲的三个核心：反问题（由中心投影、近大远小、尺度歧义逐级搭起）、景深（由对焦、模糊圈搭起）、双线性插值（由采样网格、最近邻、线性插值搭起）。一听就懂的点（图形学与视觉的方向相反、容许模糊圈）只在文案和词条里提到。技术内容（通道顺序）放在主线走完后的可选专题。视觉任务的分类、量化、裁剪等点暂不做成关。
scope.en: A demonstration course covering the three cores of lectures 1–2: the inverse problem (built up from central projection, perspective scaling and scale ambiguity), depth of field (from focus and the blur circle) and bilinear interpolation (from the sampling grid, nearest neighbour and linear interpolation). Points plain from a sentence (graphics and vision run opposite ways, the acceptable blur) are only mentioned in copy and entries. Technical content (channel order) is an optional topic once the main path ends. Vision task types, quantisation and cropping are not levels yet.

where.zh: 投影和光学两个系列：针孔相机台和薄透镜台
where.en: The projection and optics series: the pinhole and thin-lens benches

why.zh: 投影和景深是连续量之间的关系；台子让玩家先预测、再检查，检查后才画出光线和模糊曲线，猜不出来，要按关系算。
